<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/anaw/2013/6/section/62" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/anaw/2013/6/section/62" id="section-62"><Pnumber PuncAfter="">62</Pnumber><P1para><Text>In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires—</Text><UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition"><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1440067560653" CommentaryRef="key-E2">“fire and rescue authority” (“”), in relation to any land, means the fire and rescue authority under the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004 for the area in which the land is situated.</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“<Term id="term-gypsies-and-travellers">Gypsies and Travellers</Term>” (“<Term id="term-Sipsiwn-a-Theithwyr"><Emphasis>Sipsiwn a Theithwyr</Emphasis></Term>”) means <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1471340007939" CommentaryRef="key-E">—
                      </Substitution></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens"><ListItem NumberOverride="(a)"><Para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1471340007939" CommentaryRef="key-E"> persons of a nomadic habit of life, whatever their race or origin, including—</Substitution></Text></Para><Para><OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens"><ListItem NumberOverride="(i)"><Para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1471340007939" CommentaryRef="key-E">               persons who, on grounds only of their own or their family's or dependant's educational needs or old age, have ceased to travel temporarily or permanently, and</Substitution></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem NumberOverride="(ii)"><Para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1471340007939" CommentaryRef="key-E">  members of an organised group of travelling show people or circus people (whether or not travelling together as such); and</Substitution></Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList></Para></ListItem><ListItem NumberOverride="(b)"><Para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1471340007939" CommentaryRef="key-E">all other persons with a cultural tradition of nomadism or of living in a mobile home;</Substitution></Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>
“
<Term id="term-local-authority">local authority</Term>
” (“
<Term id="term-awdurdod-lleol"><Emphasis>awdurdod lleol</Emphasis></Term>
”) means the council of a Welsh county or county borough;
</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>
“
<Term id="term-local-authority-gypsy-and-traveller-site">local authority Gypsy and Traveller site</Term>
” (“
<Term id="term-safle-Sipsiwn-a-Theithwyr-awrdurdod-lleol"><Emphasis>safle Sipsiwn a Theithwyr awrdurdod lleol</Emphasis></Term>
”) has the meaning given by section 2(5);
</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>
“
<Term id="term-owner">owner</Term>
” (“
<Term id="term-perchennog"><Emphasis>perchennog</Emphasis></Term>
”) is to be construed in accordance with section 3 (but see also sections 39(2), 42 and 55(2)) and related expressions are to be construed accordingly;
</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>
“
<Term id="term-pitch-fee">pitch fee</Term>
” (“
<Term id="term-ffi-am-y-llain"><Emphasis>ffi am y llain</Emphasis></Term>
”) means the amount which the occupier of a mobile home is required by an agreement to pay for the right to station the mobile home on the pitch and for use of the common areas of the protected site and their maintenance, but does not include amounts due in respect of gas, electricity, water and sewerage or other services, unless the agreement expressly provides that the pitch fee includes such amounts;
</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>
“
<Term id="term-planning-permission">planning permission</Term>
” (“
<Term id="term-caniatâd-cynllunio"><Emphasis>caniatâd cynllunio</Emphasis></Term>
”) means permission under Part 3 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990;
</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>
“
<Term id="term-protected-site">protected site</Term>
” (“
<Term id="term-safle-gwarchodedig"><Emphasis>safle gwarchodedig</Emphasis></Term>
”) has the meaning given by section 2(2);
</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>
“
<Term id="term-regulated-site">regulated site</Term>
” (“
<Term id="term-safle-rheoleiddiedig"><Emphasis>safle rheoleiddiedig</Emphasis></Term>
”) has the meaning given by section 2(1);
</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>
“
<Term id="term-site-licence">site licence</Term>
” (“
<Term id="term-trwydded-safle"><Emphasis>trwydded safle</Emphasis></Term>
”) has the meaning given by section 5(1).
</Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>
Words in s. 62 substituted (25.2.2015) by 
<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/anaw/2014/7" id="c9jkxgur2-00007" Class="WelshNationalAssemblyAct" Year="2014" Number="7" Title="Housing (Wales) Act 2014">Housing (Wales) Act 2014 (anaw 7)</Citation>
, 
<CitationSubRef id="c9jkxgur2-00008" CitationRef="c9jkxgur2-00007" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/anaw/2014/7/section/145/3" SectionRef="section-145-3">s. 145(3)</CitationSubRef>
, 
<CitationSubRef id="c9jkxgur2-00009" CitationRef="c9jkxgur2-00007" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/anaw/2014/7/schedule/3/paragraph/26/2" SectionRef="schedule-3-paragraph-26-2" Operative="true">Sch. 3 para. 26(2)</CitationSubRef>
; 
<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/380" id="c9jkxgur2-00010" Class="WelshStatutoryInstrument" Year="2015" Number="380" Title="The Housing (Wales) Act 2014 (Commencement No. 2) Order 2015">S.I. 2015/380</Citation>
, 
<CitationSubRef id="c9jkxgur2-00011" CitationRef="c9jkxgur2-00010" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/380/article/2/h" SectionRef="article-2-h">art. 2(h)</CitationSubRef>
</Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

 means the<Addition ChangeId="d29p1612" CommentaryRef="c11601191"> Director of Public Health</Addition> of, or any other officer authorised by,  <Substitution ChangeId="d29p1616" CommentaryRef="c21310941">the Regional Agency</Substitution>;]</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“building” includes any<Addition ChangeId="d29p1624" CommentaryRef="c11601211"> vessel or aircraft</Addition>, tent, van, caravan, shed or other structure used for human habitation;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“carrier”, in relation to a notifiable disease, means a person who, while not suffering from any of the symptoms of the disease, has within his body in a communicable form, the organism which causes that disease, but does not include a person who has merely been in contact with the disease;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1632" CommentaryRef="c21310951">“</Addition><Term id="term-director-of-public-health"><Addition ChangeId="d29p1632" CommentaryRef="c21310951">Director of Public Health</Addition></Term><Addition ChangeId="d29p1632" CommentaryRef="c21310951">” means the Director of Public Health for Northern Ireland (see Article 32 of the Health and Personal Social Services (Northern Ireland) Order 1991);</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Emphasis>Definition rep. by 1972 NI 14</Emphasis></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><CommentaryRef Ref="c21310911"/>. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“house” includes any room, tenement, flat and any other part of a house;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Emphasis>Definition rep. by 1986 NI 24</Emphasis></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“infectious disease” means any infectious or contagious disease, but<Addition ChangeId="d29p1664" CommentaryRef="c11601211"> except in section 2A(1)(a)</Addition> does not include a venereal disease;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Emphasis>Definition rep. by 1972 NI 14</Emphasis></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“medical practitioner” means a fully registered person within the meaning of section 54 of the Medical Act 1956 <MarginNoteRef Ref="m00002"/>;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“Ministry” means the Ministry of Health and Social Services;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“notifiable disease” has the meaning assigned to it by section 1;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“occupier” means any person in occupation of, or having charge, management or control of, or of any part of, any building or premises;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“owner” means the person for the time being receiving the rack-rent of the premises in connection with which the word is used, whether on his own account or as agent or trustee for any other person, or who would so receive the same if the premises were let at a rack-rent;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“prescribed” means prescribed by regulations made by the Ministry under this Act;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“premises” includes messuages, buildings, lands, easements and hereditaments of any tenure;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1704" CommentaryRef="c21310971">“</Addition><Term id="term-the-regional-agency"><Addition ChangeId="d29p1704" CommentaryRef="c21310971">the Regional Agency</Addition></Term><Addition ChangeId="d29p1704" CommentaryRef="c21310971">” means the Regional Agency for Public Health and Social Well-being;</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“resident magistrate” means a resident magistrate sitting as a court of summary jurisdiction or out of petty sessions, and acting ex parte, if it be deemed necessary by the magistrate;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1718" CommentaryRef="c11601211">“vessel” has the same meaning as</Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p1718" CommentaryRef="c11601211"><Addition ChangeId="d29p1723" CommentaryRef="c11601271"> “ship” in the Merchant Shipping Act 1995</Addition></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p1718" CommentaryRef="c11601211"> except that it includes a hovercraft within the meaning of the Hovercraft Act 1968 and “master” shall be construed accordingly.</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Emphasis>Definition rep. by 1972 NI 14</Emphasis></Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary id="c11601271" Type="F"><Para><Text><Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1995/21" id="c00421" Year="1995" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Number="21">1995 c. 21</Citation></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="2009-04-01"><Title><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">Removal to hospital of person with notifiable disease.</Addition></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/3A" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/3A" id="section-3A"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">3A</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/3A/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/3A/1" id="section-3A-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">Where a resident magistrate is satisfied, on the application of  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871"><Substitution ChangeId="d29p458" CommentaryRef="c21309661">the Regional Agency</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871"> that a person is suffering from a notifiable disease and that serious risk of infection is thereby caused to other persons, the magistrate may order him to be removed to a hospital.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/3A/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/3A/2" id="section-3A-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">An order under this section may be addressed to an authorised officer and that officer and any other authorised officer may do all acts necessary for giving effect to the order.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-04-01"><Title><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">Detention in hospital of person with notifiable disease.</Addition></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/3B" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/3B" id="section-3B"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">3B</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/3B/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/3B/1" id="section-3B-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">Where a resident magistrate is satisfied, on the application of  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871"><Substitution ChangeId="d29p482" CommentaryRef="c21309681">the Regional Agency</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">, that serious risk of infection would be caused to persons if an in-patient of a hospital who is suffering from a notifiable disease were to leave the hospital, the magistrate may order the in-patient to be detained in the hospital.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/3B/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/3B/2" id="section-3B-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">An order under subsection (1) may direct detention for a period specified in the order, but any resident magistrate may extend a period so specified as often as it appears to him to be necessary to do so.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/3B/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/3B/3" id="section-3B-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">Any person who leaves a hospital contrary to an order made under this section for his detention there shall be guilty of an offence under this Part and the court may order him to be taken back to hospital.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/3B/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/3B/4" id="section-3B-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p441" CommentaryRef="c11599871">An order under this section may be addressed to an authorised officer and that officer and any other authorised officer may do all acts necessary for giving effect to the order.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Part><Commentaries><Commentary id="c11599871" Type="F"><Para><Text><Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/1986/ni24" id="c00390" Class="NorthernIrelandOrderInCouncil" Year="1986" AlternativeNumber="24">1986 NI 24</Citation></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_apni_1967_36/ef55d6a0ce.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1967/36/section/15/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1967/36/section/15/3" id="section-15-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>An order made under subsection (2) shall continue in force indefinitely or until a date expressed in the order, so, however, that a resident magistrate may at any time revoke the order on the application of  <Substitution ChangeId="d29p1004" CommentaryRef="c21391661">the Director of Public Health</Substitution> or the person affected by the order.</Text></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="c21391661" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in Act substituted (1.4.2009) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2009/1" id="c00230" Class="NorthernIrelandAct" Year="2009" Number="1" Title="Health and Social Care (Reform) Act (Northern Ireland) 2009">Health and Social Care (Reform) Act (Northern Ireland) 2009 (c. 1)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c00230" id="c00231" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2009/1/section/32" SectionRef="section-32">ss. 32</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c00230" id="c00232" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2009/1/section/34/3" SectionRef="section-34-3">34(3)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c00230" id="c00233" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2009/1/schedule/6/paragraph/2/1" SectionRef="schedule-6-paragraph-2-1" Operative="true">Sch. 6 para. 2(1)</CitationSubRef>; <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/114" id="c00234" Class="NorthernIrelandStatutoryRule" Year="2009" Number="114">S.R. 2009/114</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c00234" id="c00235" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/114/article/2" SectionRef="article-2" Operative="true">art. 2</CitationSubRef></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

<Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/apni/1969/6/section/158/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/apni/1969/6/section/158/1" id="section-158-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this Act—</Text><UnorderedList Decoration="none"><ListItem><Para><Text><Emphasis>Definition rep. by SR 1981/339</Emphasis></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>[<CommentaryRef Ref="c5453651"/> “central rescue station” means a station providing facilities common to a number of mines for the conduct of fire-fighting and rescue operations;]</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“contravention” includes, in relation to—</Text></Para><OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens"><ListItem NumberOverride="a"><Para><Text>a direction, prohibition, restriction or requirement given or imposed by a notice served under or by virtue of this Act by<Addition ChangeId="d29p5047" CommentaryRef="c5453661"> the Executive</Addition> or an inspector; or</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem NumberOverride="b"><Para><Text>a condition attached to an exemption, consent, approval or authority granted or given under or by virtue of this Act by<Addition ChangeId="d29p5055" CommentaryRef="c5453661"> the Executive</Addition> or by an inspector exercising any function conferred on him under section 120(3); [<CommentaryRef Ref="c5453701"/> or</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem NumberOverride="c"><Para><Text>a prohibition or requirement imposed by or under health and safety regulations which expressly apply to all mines, any class of mine or a particular mine;]</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList><Para><Text>a failure to comply with the direction, prohibition, restriction, requirement or condition, and the expression “contravene” shall be construed accordingly;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5068" CommentaryRef="c5453661">“the Department” means the Department of Economic Development</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“doctor” means a fully registered person within the meaning of<Addition ChangeId="d29p5078" CommentaryRef="c5453731"> section 55 of the Medical Act 1983</Addition>;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5082" CommentaryRef="c5453661">“the Executive” means the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“gas” includes fume or vapour;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“gravity operated rope haulage apparatus” means rope haulage apparatus worked solely by the action of gravity on a vehicle or vehicles attached to a rope forming part of the apparatus;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“gravity operated winding apparatus” means winding apparatus worked solely by the action of gravity on a part of it in which a load is carried;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>[<CommentaryRef Ref="c5453701"/> “health and safety regulations”

 has the meaning assigned to it by Article 17(1) of the Health and Safety at Work (Northern Ireland) Order 1978 <MarginNoteRef Ref="m00009"/>;]</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“inset” means, in relation to shaft or outlet of a mine, a heading, chamber or other space driven or excavated from the shaft or outlet, being a heading, chamber or space to which access can only be had from the shaft or outlet and not being a heading, chamber or space the sole or main purpose of the driving or excavation of which is the getting of minerals or products of minerals;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>[<CommentaryRef Ref="c5453651"/> “inspector”

 means an inspector appointed by<Addition ChangeId="d29p5119" CommentaryRef="c5453661"> the Executive</Addition> under Article 21 of the Health and Safety at Work (Northern Ireland) Order 1978 for carrying into effect the provisions of the Act of 1969;]</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“legal proceedings” includes arbitration;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“mechanically operated rope haulage apparatus” means rope haulage apparatus worked by a stationary engine;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“mechanically operated winding apparatus” means winding apparatus worked by a stationary engine;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“minerals” includes stone, slate, clay, gravel, sand and other natural deposits except peat;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Emphasis>Definition rep. by SR 1999/150</Emphasis></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“notice” means a notice in writing;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“parent” means a parent<Addition ChangeId="d29p5153" CommentaryRef="c5453811"> of a young person or any person who is not a parent of his but who has parental responsibility for him (within the meaning of the Children (Northern Ireland) Order 1995)</Addition>, and includes, in relation to any young person, a person having direct benefit from his wages;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“permitted lights” means, in relation to a mine or a part of a mine, locked safety-lamps and any other means of lighting the use of which below ground in mines generally, in mines of a class to which that mine belongs or in that mine is authorised by regulations<Addition ChangeId="d29p5161" CommentaryRef="c5453831"> or health and safety regulations</Addition>;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“prescribed” has the meaning assigned to it by section 120(5);</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“railway company” means any person working a railway that is used for the purposes of public traffic, whether passenger, goods or other traffic;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“regulations”, “general regulations” and “special regulations” have, subject to subsection (5) of section 120 the meanings respectively assigned to them by that subsection;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“road” does not include an unwalkable outlet;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“rope” includes chain;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“rope haulage apparatus” means apparatus for transporting loads in vehicles attached to ropes;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“safety-lamp mine” means a mine in no part of which below ground is the use of lamps or lights other than permitted lights lawful;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“safety-lamp part of a mine” means a part of a mine other than a safety-lamp mine, being a part below ground in which either the use of lamps or lights other than permitted lights is unlawful or safety-lamps are for the time being in use by way of temporary precaution;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“sanitary conveniences” includes urinals, water-closets, earth-closets, ash-pits, privies and any similar convenience;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“shaft” means a shaft the top of which is, or is intended to be, at the surface;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“staple-pit” means a shaft connecting two or more levels of underground working and not connecting any such level directly to the surface, and includes a winze;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“statutory responsibilities” means responsibilities under this Act, orders made thereunder and regulations;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“support rules” has the meaning assigned to it by section 54(1);</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“transport rules” has the meaning assigned to it by section 37(1);</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“unwalkable outlet” means an outlet which, owing to the gradient thereof or of any part thereof (whether alone or in combination with other circumstances), persons cannot walk up with reasonable convenience;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“winding apparatus” means, in relation to a mine shaft or staple-pit, apparatus for lowering and raising loads through the shaft or staple-pit;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“woman” means a woman who has attained the age of eighteen years;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“young person” means a person who is over compulsory school age but has not attained the age of eighteen years.</Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="c5453731" Type="F"><Para><Text><Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1983/54" id="c00013" Year="1983" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Number="54">1983 c. 54</Citation></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_asp_2009_12/185ed7552b.xml: PART 2A<Addition ChangeId="key-E-1590484585427" CommentaryRef="key-E">Citizens Assembly</Addition><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1590484585427" CommentaryRef="key-E">Citizens assembly</Addition>32A1The Scottish Ministers must establish a panel to be known as a “citizens assembly” to exercise the functions mentioned in subsection (5).2The citizens assembly is a panel made up of such persons as the Scottish Ministers consider to be representative of the general populace of Scotland.3The citizens assembly is to have two conveners who are independent of the Scottish Ministers and the Scottish Parliament.4There is to be a gender balance between the conveners.5The functions conferred on the citizens assembly are to—aconsider how to prevent or minimise, or remedy or mitigate the effects of, climate change,bmake recommendations on measures proposed to achieve the emissions reduction targets,cmake recommendations about such other matters in relation to climate change as the Scottish Ministers may, in accordance with subsection (6), refer to the assembly.6The Scottish Ministers may refer matters to the citizens assembly under subsection (5)(c) only if those matters have been approved by resolution of the Scottish Parliament.7The Scottish Ministers must, before the first meeting of the citizens assembly, lay before the Scottish Parliament a report on the arrangements for the administration and operation of the assembly.8The citizens assembly is to—aset out its recommendations in a report,blay the report before the Scottish Parliament, andcsend a copy of the report to the Scottish Ministers.9The Scottish Ministers must, within 6 months of receiving a copy of the report, publish a statement setting out how they intend to respond to the recommendations made in it.10The citizens assembly is to—alay its report before the Scottish Parliament under subsection (8)(b) by 28 February 2021 or, if it is unable to lay the report by that date for a reason relating to coronavirus, as soon as reasonably practicable after that date,bcomplete its consideration of the matters mentioned in subsection (5)(a) by the date on which its report is so laid.11In subsection (10)(a), “coronavirus” has the meaning given by section 1 of the Coronavirus (Scotland) Act 2020.Pt. 2A inserted (23.3.2020) by Climate Change (Emissions Reduction Targets) (Scotland) Act 2019 (asp 15), ss. 9, 32(2); S.S.I. 2020/66, reg. 2

on on the premises..5In section 148 (index of defined expressions), in the table, insert at the appropriate place—
interested partysection 147(5).

DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/170/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/170/2" id="section-170-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>P is DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171" id="section-171"><Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E6"/>171</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/1" id="section-171-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>This section applies if—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/1/a" id="section-171-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>a penalty period has begun under section 170 because P has failed to make a payment (“payment A”), and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/1/b" id="section-171-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>before the end of the period, P fails to make another payment (“payment B”) falling within the same item in the table in section 168 as payment A.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/2" id="section-171-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In such a case—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/2/a" id="section-171-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>section 170(2) and (3) do not apply to the failure to make payment B,</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/2/b" id="section-171-2-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>P is liable to a penalty under this section for that failure, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/2/c" id="section-171-2-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the penalty period that has begun is extended so that it ends with the day 12 months after the date specified in or for the purposes of column 4 for payment B.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/3" id="section-171-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The amount of the penalty under this section is determined by reference to the number of defaults that P has made during the penalty period.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/4" id="section-171-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If the default is P's first default during the penalty period, P is liable, at the time of the default, to a penalty of 2% of the amount of the default.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/5" id="section-171-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If the default is P's second default during the penalty period, P is liable, at the time of the default, to a penalty of 3% of the amount of the default.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/6" id="section-171-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If the default is P's third or subsequent default during the penalty period, P is liable, at the time of the default, to a penalty of 4% of the amount of the default.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/7" id="section-171-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For the id="section-171-7-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>P makes a default when P fails to pay an amount of tax in full on or before the date on which it becomes due and payable,</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/7/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/7/b" id="section-171-7-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in accordance with subsection (1)(b), the references in subsections (3) to (6) to a default are references to a default in relation to the tax to which payments A and B relate,</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/7/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/7/c" id="section-171-7-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>a default counts for the purposes of those subsections if (but only if) the period to which the payment relates is less than 6 months,</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/7/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/7/d" id="section-171-7-d"><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the amount of a default is the amount which P fails to pay.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asp/2014/16/section/171/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asp/2014/16/section/171/8" id="section-171-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A penalty period may be extended more than once under subsection (2)(c).</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2026-04-01"><Title><Substitution ChangeId="key-E7-1778152979362" CommentaryRef="key-E7">Scottish landfill tax and <Legislation><P1group RestrictStartDate="2008-12-11" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">Implementation reports</Addition>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/391/article/17a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/391/article/17a" id="article-17a">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 17a</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/1" id="article-17a-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">Every five years, the Member States shall submit a single report to the Commission on the practical implementation of this Directive and individual Directives within the meaning of Article 16(1), indicating the points of view of the social partners. The report shall assess the various points related to the practical implementation of the different Directives and, where appropriate and available, provide data disaggregated by gender.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/2" id="article-17a-2">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">The structure of the report, together with a questionnaire specifying its content, shall be defined by the Commission, in cooperation with the Advisory Committee on Safety and Health at Work.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">The report shall include a general part on the provisions of this Directive relating to the common principles and points applicable to all of the Directives referred to in paragraph 1.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">To complement the general part, specific chapters shall deal with implementation of the particular aspects of each Directive, including specific indicators, where available.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/3" id="article-17a-3">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">3</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">The Commission shall submit the structure of the report, together with the above-mentioned questionnaire specifying its content, to the Member States at least six months before the end of the period covered by the report. The report shall be transmitted to the Commission within 12 months of the end of the five-year period that it covers.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/4" id="article-17a-4">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">4</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">Using these reports as a basis, the Commission shall evaluate the implementation of the Directives concerned in terms of their relevance, of research and of new scientific knowledge in the various fields in question. It shall, within 36 months of the end of the five-year period, inform the European Parliament, the Council, the European Economic and Social Committee and the Advisory Committee on Safety and Health at Work of the results of this evaluation and, if necessary, of any initiatives to improve the operation of the regulatory framework.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/391/article/17a/5" id="article-17a-5">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">5</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">The first report shall cover the period 2007 to 2012.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000003">
         <Para>
            <Text>Inserted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2007" Number="30" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2007/30" Title="Directive 2007/30/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2007 amending Council Directive 89/391/EEC, its individual Directives and Council Directives 83/477/EEC, 91/383/EEC, 92/29/EEC and 94/33/EC with a view to simplifying and rationalising the reports on practical implementation (Text with EEA relevance)">Directive 2007/30/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2007 amending Council Directive 89/391/EEC, its individual Directives and Council Directives 83/477/EEC, 91/383/EEC, 92/29/EEC and 94/33/EC with a view to simplifying and rationalising the reports on practical implementation (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_1989_391/87e10009e2.xml:

                     <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>It shall be the responsibility of each worker to take care as far as possible of his own safety and health and that of other persons affected by his <Substitution ChangeId="O000001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001" Correction="true">acts or omissions</Substitution> at work in accordance with his training and the instructions given by his employer.</Text>

      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_1989_654/62f730e65d.xml:
<Legislation><EUSection DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/section/III" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/section/III" NumberOfProvisions="5" id="section-III" RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I."><P1group RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Exercise of the delegation</Addition>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9a" id="article-9a">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 9a</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/1" id="article-9a-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">The power to adopt delegated acts is conferred on the Commission subject to the conditions laid down in this Article.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/2" id="article-9a-2">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Article 9 shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from </Addition>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">26 July 2019</Addition>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">. The Commission shall draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/3" id="article-9a-3">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">3</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">The delegation of power referred to in Article 9 may be revoked at any time by the European Parliament or by the Council. A decision to revoke shall put an end to the delegation of the power specified in that decision. It shall take effect the day following the publication of the decision in the </Addition>
                              <Emphasis>
                                 <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Official Journal of the European Union</Addition>
                              </Emphasis>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003"> or at a later date specified therein. It shall not affect the validity of any delegated acts already in force.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/4" id="article-9a-4">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">4</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of </Addition>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">13 April 2016</Addition>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003"> on Better Law-Making</Addition>
                              <FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/5" id="article-9a-5">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">5</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9a/6" id="article-9a-6">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">6</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">A delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 9 shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or the Council within a period of two months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by two months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Urgency procedure</Addition>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9b" id="article-9b">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 9b</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9b/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9b/1" id="article-9b-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Delegated acts adopted under this Article shall enter into force without delay and shall apply as long as no objection is expressed in accordance with paragraph 2. The notification of a delegated act to the European Parliament and the Council shall state the reasons for the use of the urgency procedure.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9b/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9b/2" id="article-9b-2">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Either the European Parliament or the Council may object to a delegated act in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 9a(6). In such a case, the Commission shall repeal the act immediately following the notification of the decision to object by the European Parliament or by the Council.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group></EUSection><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000003">
         <Para>
            <Text>Inserted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2019" Number="1243" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2019/1243" Title="Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)">Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_1989_654/80d815c4fd.xml:
<Legislation><P1group RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">Amendments to the Annexes</Substitution>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/654/article/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/654/article/9" id="article-9">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">Article 9</Substitution>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <Text>
                        <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 9a to make strictly technical amendments to the Annexes, in order to take account of technical harmonisation and standardisation of the design, manufacture or construction of parts of workplaces, technical progress, changes in international regulations or specifications and knowledge with regard to workplaces.</Substitution>
                     </Text>
                  </P1para>
                  <P1para>
                     <Text>
                        <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">Where, in duly justified and exceptional cases involving imminent, direct and serious risks to workers’ and other persons’ physical health and safety, imperative grounds of urgency require action in a very short timeframe, the procedure provided for in Article 9b shall apply to delegated acts adopted pursuant to this Article.</Substitution>
                     </Text>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000002">
         <Para>
            <Text>Substituted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2019" Number="1243" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2019/1243" Title="Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)">Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

<Legislation><EUSection DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/section/III" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/section/III" NumberOfProvisions="5" id="section-III" RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I."><P1group RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Exercise of the delegation</Addition>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9a" id="article-9a">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 9a</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/1" id="article-9a-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">The power to adopt delegated acts is conferred on the Commission subject to the conditions laid down in this Article.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/2" id="article-9a-2">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Article 9 shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from </Addition>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">26 July 2019</Addition>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">. The Commission shall draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/3" id="article-9a-3">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">3</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">The delegation of power referred to in Article 9 may be revoked at any time by the European Parliament or by the Council. A decision to revoke shall put an end to the delegation of the power specified in that decision. It shall take effect the day following the publication of the decision in the </Addition>
                              <Emphasis>
                                 <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Official Journal of the European Union</Addition>
                              </Emphasis>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003"> or at a later date specified therein. It shall not affect the validity of any delegated acts already in force.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/4" id="article-9a-4">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">4</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of </Addition>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">13 April 2016</Addition>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003"> on Better Law-Making</Addition>
                              <FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/5" id="article-9a-5">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">5</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9a/6" id="article-9a-6">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">6</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">A delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 9 shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or the Council within a period of two months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by two months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Urgency procedure</Addition>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9b" id="article-9b">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 9b</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9b/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9b/1" id="article-9b-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Delegated acts adopted under this Article shall enter into force without delay and shall apply as long as no objection is expressed in accordance with paragraph 2. The notification of a delegated act to the European Parliament and the Council shall state the reasons for the use of the urgency procedure.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9b/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9b/2" id="article-9b-2">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Either the European Parliament or the Council may object to a delegated act in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 9a(6). In such a case, the Commission shall repeal the act immediately following the notification of the decision to object by the European Parliament or by the Council.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group></EUSection><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000003">
         <Para>
            <Text>Inserted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2019" Number="1243" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2019/1243" Title="Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)">Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

<Legislation><P1group RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">Amendments to the Annexes</Substitution>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1989/656/article/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1989/656/article/9" id="article-9">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">Article 9</Substitution>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <Text>
                        <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 9a to make strictly technical amendments to the Annexes, in order to take account of technical harmonisation and standardisation relating to personal protective equipment, technical progress, changes in international regulations or specifications and knowledge in the field of personal protective equipment.</Substitution>
                     </Text>
                  </P1para>
                  <P1para>
                     <Text>
                        <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">Where, in duly justified and exceptional cases involving imminent, direct and serious risks to workers’ and other persons’ physical health and safety, imperative grounds of urgency require action in a very short timeframe, the procedure provided for in Article 9b shall apply to delegated acts adopted pursuant to this Article.</Substitution>
                     </Text>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000002">
         <Para>
            <Text>Substituted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2019" Number="1243" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2019/1243" Title="Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)">Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

                  <Pnumber>
                     <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 8b</Addition>

<Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/3/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
                     <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>The client or the project supervisor shall ensure that prior to the setting up of a construction site a safety and health plan is drawn up in accordance with Article 5 (b).</Text>
                     </P2para>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>
                           <Substitution ChangeId="O001001M002" CommentaryRef="c000002" Correction="true">The Member States may, after consulting both management and the workforce, allow derogations from the provisions of the first subparagraph, except where it is a question of:</Substitution>
                        </Text>
                     </P2para>
                     <P2para>
                        <UnorderedList Decoration="dash">
                           <ListItem>
                              <Para>
                                 <Text>
                                    <Substitution ChangeId="O001001M002" CommentaryRef="c000002" Correction="true">work involving particular risks as listed in Annex II, or</Substitution>
                                 </Text>
                              </Para>
                           </ListItem>
                           <ListItem>
                              <Para>
                                 <Text>
                                    <Substitution ChangeId="O001001M002" CommentaryRef="c000002" Correction="true">work for which prior notice is required pursuant to paragraph 3 of this Article.</Substitution>
                                 </Text>
                              </Para>
                           </ListItem>
                        </UnorderedList>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2><Commentaries><Commentary Type="X" Source="EU" id="c000002">
         <Para>
            <Text>Substituted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionCorrigendum" Year="1992" Number="57" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/pdfs/eudrcs_19920057_en_002.pdf" Title="Corrigendum to Council Directive 92/57/EEC of 24 June 1992 on the implementation of minimum safety and health requirements at temporary or mobile construction sites (eighth individual Directive within the meaning of Article 16 (1) of Directive 89/391/EEC) (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 245 of 26 August 1992)">Corrigendum to Council Directive 92/57/EEC of 24 June 1992 on the implementation of minimum safety and health requirements at temporary or mobile construction sites (eighth individual Directive within the meaning of Article 16 (1) of Directive 89/391/EEC) (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 245 of 26 August 1992)</Citation>.</Text>
