                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/13a/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/13a/3" id="article-13a-3">
                     <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">3</Addition>
                     </Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">The delegation of power referred to in Article 13 may be revoked at any time by the European Parliament or by the Council. A decision to revoke shall put an end to the delegation of the power specified in that decision. It shall take effect the day following the publication of the decision in the </Addition>
                           <Emphasis>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">Official Journal of the European Union</Addition>
                           </Emphasis>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004"> or at a later date specified therein. It shall not affect the validity of any delegated acts already in force.</Addition>
                        </Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/13a/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/13a/4" id="article-13a-4">
                     <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">4</Addition>
                     </Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of </Addition>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">13 April 2016</Addition>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004"> on Better Law-Making</Addition>
                           <FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">.</Addition>
                        </Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/13a/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/13a/5" id="article-13a-5">
                     <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">5</Addition>
                     </Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.</Addition>
                        </Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/13a/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/13a/6" id="article-13a-6">
                     <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">6</Addition>
                     </Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">A delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 13 shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or the Council within a period of two months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by two months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.</Addition>
                        </Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
               </P1para>
            </P1>
         </P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
            <Title>
               <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">Urgency procedure</Addition>
            </Title>
            <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/13b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/13b" id="article-13b">
               <Pnumber>
                  <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">Article 13b</Addition>
               </Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/13b/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/13b/1" id="article-13b-1">
                     <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">1</Addition>
                     </Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">Delegated acts adopted under this Article shall enter into force without delay and shall apply as long as no objection is expressed in accordance with paragraph 2. The notification of a delegated act to the European Parliament and the Council shall state the reasons for the use of the urgency procedure.</Addition>
                        </Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/13b/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/13b/2" id="article-13b-2">
                     <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">2</Addition>
                     </Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O002001M002" CommentaryRef="c000004">Either the European Parliament or the Council may object to a delegated act in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 13a(6). In such a case, the Commission shall repeal the act immediately following the notification of the decision to object by the European Parliament or by the Council.</Addition>
                        </Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
               </P1para>
            </P1>
         </P1group></EUBody></EURetained></Legislation><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000004">
         <Para>
            <Text>Inserted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2019" Number="1243" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2019/1243" Title="Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)">Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_1992_57/80d815c4fd.xml:
<Legislation><P1group RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
            <Title>
               <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">Amendments to Annex IV</Substitution>
            </Title>
            <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/13" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/13" id="article-13">
               <Pnumber>
                  <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 13</Substitution>
               </Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <Text>
                     <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 13a to make strictly technical amendments to Annex IV, in order to take account of technical harmonisation and standardisation regarding temporary or mobile construction sites, as well as technical progress, changes in international regulations or specifications and knowledge in the field of temporary or mobile construction sites.</Substitution>
                  </Text>
               </P1para>
               <P1para>
                  <Text>
                     <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000003">Where, in duly justified and exceptional cases involving imminent, direct and serious risks to workers’ and other persons’ physical health and safety, imperative grounds of urgency require action in a very short timeframe, the procedure provided for in Article 13b shall apply to delegated acts adopted pursuant to this Article.</Substitution>
                  </Text>
               </P1para>
            </P1>
         </P1group><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000003">
         <Para>
            <Text>Substituted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2019" Number="1243" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2019/1243" Title="Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)">Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_1992_57/bc2df6b086.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1992/57/article/2" id="article-2">
               <Pnumber>Article 2</Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <Text>For the purposes of this Directive:</Text>
               </P1para>
               <P1para>
                  <OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
                     <ListItem NumberOverride="(a)">
                        <Para>
                           <Text>‘temporary or mobile construction sites’ (hereinafter referred to as ‘construction sites’) means any construction site at which building or civil engineering works are carried out; a non-exhaustive list of such works is given in Annex I;</Text>
                        </Para>
                     </ListItem>
                     <ListItem NumberOverride="(b)">
                        <Para>
                           <Text>‘client’ means any natural or legal person for whom a project is carried out;</Text>
                        </Para>
                     </ListItem>
                     <ListItem NumberOverride="(c)">
                        <Para>
                           <Text>‘project supervisor’ means any natural or legal person responsible for the design and/or execution and/or supervision of the execution of a project, acting on behalf of the client;</Text>
                        </Para>
                     </ListItem>
                     <ListItem NumberOverride="(d)">
                        <Para>
                           <Text>‘self-employed person’ means any person other than those referred to in Article 3 (a) and (b) of Directive 89/391/EEC whose professional activity contributes to the completion of a project;</Text>
                        </Para>
                     </ListItem>
                     <ListItem NumberOverride="(e)">
                        <Para>
                           <Text>‘coordinator for safety and health matters at the project preparations stage’ means any natural or legal person entrusted by the client and/or project supervisor, <Substitution ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000001" Correction="true">during the project preparation stage</Substitution>, with performing the duties referred to in Article 5;</Text>
                        </Para>
                     </ListItem>
                     <ListItem NumberOverride="(f)">
                        <Para>
                           <Text>‘coordinator for safety and health matters at the project execution stage’ means any natural or legal person entrusted by the client and/or project supervisor, during execution of the project, with performing the duties referred to in Article 6.</Text>
                        </Para>
                     </ListItem>
                  </OrderedList>
               </P1para>
            </P1><Commentaries><Commentary Type="X" Source="EU" id="c000001">
         <Para>
            <Text>Substituted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionCorrigendum" Year="1992" Number="57" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1992/57/pdfs/eudrcs_19920057_en_001.pdf" Title="Corrigendum to Council Directive 92/57/EEC of 24 June 1992 on the implementation of minimum safety and health requirements at temporary or mobile construction sites (eighth individual Directive within the meaning of Article 16 (1) of Directive 89/391/EEC) (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 245 of 26 August 1992)">Corrigendum to Council Directive 92/57/EEC of 24 June 1992 on the implementation of minimum safety and health requirements at temporary or mobile construction sites (eighth individual Directive within the meaning of Article 16 (1) of Directive 89/391/EEC) (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 245 of 26 August 1992)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

            <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1994/63/article/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1994/63/article/9" id="article-9">
               <Pnumber>

UK_eudr_1998_24/00b50c5140.xml:
<Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1998/24/article/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1998/24/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>In carrying out the obligations laid down in Articles 6(3) and 9(1) of Directive 89/391/EEC, the employer shall first determine whether any hazardous chemical agents are present at the workplace. If so, he shall then assess any risk to the safety and health of workers arising from the presence of those chemical agents, taking into consideration the following:</Text>
                        </P2para>
                        <P2para>
                           <UnorderedList Decoration="dash">
                              <ListItem>
                                 <Para>
                                    <Text>their hazardous properties,</Text>
                                 </Para>
                              </ListItem>
                              <ListItem>
                                 <Para>
                                    <Text>
                                       <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M004" CommentaryRef="c000001">information on safety and health that shall be provided by the supplier (e.g. the relevant safety data sheet in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council</Substitution>
                                       <FootnoteRef Ref="f00020"/>
                                       <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M004" CommentaryRef="c000001">),</Substitution>
                                    </Text>
                                 </Para>
                              </ListItem>
                              <ListItem>
                                 <Para>
                                    <Text>the level, type and duration of exposure,</Text>
                                 </Para>
                              </ListItem>
                              <ListItem>
                                 <Para>
                                    <Text>the circumstances of work involving such agents, including their amount,</Text>
                                 </Para>
                              </ListItem>
                              <ListItem>
                                 <Para>
                                    <Text>any occupational exposure limit values or biological limit values established on the territory of the Member State in question,</Text>
                                 </Para>
                              </ListItem>
                              <ListItem>
                                 <Para>
                                    <Text>the effect of preventive measures taken or to be taken,</Text>
                                 </Para>
                              </ListItem>
                              <ListItem>
                                 <Para>
                                    <Text>where available, the conclusions to be drawn from any health surveillance already undertaken.</Text>
                                 </Para>
                              </ListItem>
                           </UnorderedList>
                        </P2para>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>The employer shall obtain additional information which is needed for the risk assessment from the supplier or from other readily available sources. Where appropriate, this information shall comprise the specific assessment concerning the risk to users established on the basis of Community legislation on chemical agents.</Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000001">
         <Para>
            <Text>Substituted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2014" Number="27" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2014/27" Title="Directive 2014/27/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 February 2014 amending Council Directives 92/58/EEC, 92/85/EEC, 94/33/EC, 98/24/EC and Directive 2004/37/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council, in order to align them to Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 on classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures">Directive 2014/27/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 February 2014 amending Council Directives 92/58/EEC, 92/85/EEC, 94/33/EC, 98/24/EC and Directive 2004/37/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council, in order to align them to Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 on classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_1998_24/b6013302ba.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/1998/24/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/1998/24/article/2" id="article-2">
                  <Pnumber>Article 2</Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <Text>For the purpose of this Directive, the terms used shall have the following meanings:</Text>
                  </P1para>
                  <P1para>
                     <OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
                        <ListItem NumberOverride="(a)">
                           <Para>
                              <Text>‘Chemical agent’ means any chemical element or compound, on its own or admixed, as it occurs in the natural state or as produced, used or released, including release as waste, by any work activity, whether or not produced intentionally and whether or not placed on the market;</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem NumberOverride="(b)">
                           <Para>
                              <Text>‘Hazardous chemical agent’ means:</Text>
                           </Para>
                           <Para>
                              <OrderedList Type="roman" Decoration="parens">
                                 <ListItem NumberOverride="(i)">
                                    <Para>
                                       <Text>
                                          <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001">any chemical agent which meets the criteria for classification as hazardous within any physical and/or health hazard classes laid down in Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council</Substitution>
                                          <FootnoteRef Ref="f00019"/>
                                          <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001">, whether or not that chemical agent is classified under that Regulation;</Substitution>
                                       </Text>
                                    </Para>
                                 </ListItem>
                                 <ListItem NumberOverride="(ii)">
                                    <Para>
                                       <Text>
                                          <Repeal ChangeId="O002001M002000" CommentaryRef="c000002">. . . . .</Repeal>
                                       </Text>
                                    </Para>
                                 </ListItem>
                                 <ListItem NumberOverride="(iii)">
                                    <Para>
                                       <Text>
                                          <Substitution ChangeId="O002001M003" CommentaryRef="c000001">any chemical agent which, whilst not meeting the criteria for classification as hazardous in accordance with point (i) of point (b) of this Article may, because of its physico-chemical, chemical or toxicological properties and the way it is used or is present in the workplace, present a risk to the safety and health of workers, including any chemical agent that is assigned an occupational exposure limit value under Article 3;</Substitution>
                                       </Text>
                                    </Para>
                                 </ListItem>
                              </OrderedList>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem NumberOverride="(c)">
                           <Para>
                              <Text>‘Activity involving chemical agents’ means any work in which chemical agents are used, or are intended to be used, in any process, including production, handling, storage, transport or disposal and treatment, or which result from such work;</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem NumberOverride="(d)">
                           <Para>
                              <Text>‘Occupational exposure limit value’ means, unless otherwise specified, the limit of the time-weighted average of the concentration of a chemical agent in the air within the breathing zone of a worker in relation to a specified reference period;</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem NumberOverride="(e)">
                           <Para>
                              <Text>‘Biological limit value’ means the limit of the concentration in the appropriate biological medium of the relevant agent, its metabolite, or an indicator of effect;</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem NumberOverride="(f)">
                           <Para>
                              <Text>‘Health surveillance’ means the assessment of an individual worker to determine the state of health of that individual, as related to exposure to specific chemical agents at work;</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem NumberOverride="(g)">
                           <Para>
                              <Text>‘Hazard’ means the intrinsic property of a chemical agent with the potential to cause harm;</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem NumberOverride="(h)">
                           <Para>
                              <Text>‘Risk’ means the likelihood that the potential for harm will be attained under the conditions of use and/or exposure.</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                     </OrderedList>
                  </P1para>
               </P1><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000002">
         <Para>
            <Text>Deleted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2014" Number="27" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2014/27" Title="Directive 2014/27/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 February 2014 amending Council Directives 92/58/EEC, 92/85/EEC, 94/33/EC, 98/24/EC and Directive 2004/37/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council, in order to align them to Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 on classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures">Directive 2014/27/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 February 2014 amending Council Directives 92/58/EEC, 92/85/EEC, 94/33/EC, 98/24/EC and Directive 2004/37/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council, in order to align them to Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 on classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_2008_98/a0306109d6.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2008/98/article/35" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2008/98/article/35" id="article-35">
                  <Pnumber>Article 35</Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2008/98/article/35/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2008/98/article/35/1" id="article-35-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Substitution ChangeId="O003002M058" CommentaryRef="c000001">1</Substitution>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Substitution ChangeId="O003002M058" CommentaryRef="c000001">The establishments and undertakings referred to in Article 23(1), the producers of hazardous waste, and the establishments and undertakings which collect or transport hazardous waste on a professional basis, or act as dealers and brokers of hazardous waste, shall keep a chronological record of:</Substitution>
                           </Text>
                           <P3>
                              <Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">
                                 <Substitution ChangeId="O003002M058" CommentaryRef="c000001">a</Substitution>
                              </Pnumber>
                              <P3para>
                                 <Text>
                                    <Substitution ChangeId="O003002M058" CommentaryRef="c000001">the quantity, nature and origin of that waste and the quantity of products and materials resulting from preparing for re-use, recycling or other recovery operations; and</Substitution>
                                 </Text>
                              </P3para>
                           </P3>
                           <P3>
                              <Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">
                                 <Substitution ChangeId="O003002M058" CommentaryRef="c000001">b</Substitution>
                              </Pnumber>
                              <P3para>
                                 <Text>
                                    <Substitution ChangeId="O003002M058" CommentaryRef="c000001">where relevant, the destination, frequency of collection, mode of transport and treatment method foreseen in respect of the waste.</Substitution>
                                 </Text>
                              </P3para>
                           </P3>
                        </P2para>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Substitution ChangeId="O003002M058" CommentaryRef="c000001">They shall make that data available to the competent authorities through the electronic registry or registries to be established pursuant to paragraph 4 of this Article.</Substitution>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2008/98/article/35/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2008/98/article/35/2" id="article-35-2">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>For hazardous waste, the records shall be preserved for at least three years except in the case of establishments and undertakings transporting hazardous waste which must keep such records for at least 12 months.</Text>
                        </P2para>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>Documentary evidence that the management operations have been carried out shall be supplied at the request of the competent authorities or of a previous holder.</Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2008/98/article/35/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2008/98/article/35/3" id="article-35-3">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>Member States may require the producers of non-hazardous waste to comply with paragraphs 1 and 2.</Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2008/98/article/35/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2008/98/article/35/4" id="article-35-4">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003002M059" CommentaryRef="c000002">4</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003002M059" CommentaryRef="c000002">Member States shall set up an electronic registry or coordinated registries to record the data on hazardous waste referred to in paragraph 1 covering the entire geographical territory of the Member State concerned. Member States may establish such registries for other waste streams, in particular for those waste streams for which targets are set in legislative acts of the Union. Member States shall use the data on waste reported by industrial operators in the European Pollutant Release and Transfer Register set up under Regulation (EC) No 166/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council</Addition>
                              <FootnoteRef Ref="f00032"/>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003002M059" CommentaryRef="c000002">.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2008/98/article/35/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2008/98/article/35/5" id="article-35-5">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003002M059" CommentaryRef="c000002">5</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003002M059" CommentaryRef="c000002">The Commission may adopt implementing acts to establish minimum conditions for the operation of such registries. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 39(2).</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                  </P1para>
               </P1><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000002">
         <Para>
            <Text>Inserted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2018" Number="851" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2018/851" Title="Directive (EU) 2018/851 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 30 May 2018 amending Directive 2008/98/EC on waste (Text with EEA relevance)">Directive (EU) 2018/851 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 30 May 2018 amending Directive 2008/98/EC on waste (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_2009_148/bc2df6b086.xml:
<Legislation><Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148" NumberOfProvisions="28" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="2.0" RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I."><EURetained><EUBody DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/body" NumberOfProvisions="28" RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I."><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18a" id="article-18a" RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
            <Pnumber>
               <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 18a</Addition>
            </Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/1" id="article-18a-1">
                  <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                     <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">The power to adopt delegated acts is conferred on the Commission subject to the conditions laid down in this Article.</Addition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/2" id="article-18a-2">
                  <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                     <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Article 18(2) shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from </Addition>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">26 July 2019</Addition>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">. The Commission shall draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.</Addition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/3" id="article-18a-3">
                  <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                     <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">3</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">The delegation of power referred to in Article 18(2) may be revoked at any time by the European Parliament or by the Council. A decision to revoke shall put an end to the delegation of the power specified in that decision. It shall take effect the day following the publication of the decision in the </Addition>
                        <Emphasis>
                           <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">Official Journal of the European Union</Addition>
                        </Emphasis>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003"> or at a later date specified therein. It shall not affect the validity of any delegated acts already in force.</Addition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/4" id="article-18a-4">
                  <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                     <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">4</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of </Addition>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">13 April 2016</Addition>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003"> on Better Law-Making</Addition>
                        <FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">.</Addition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/5" id="article-18a-5">
                  <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                     <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">5</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.</Addition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18a/6" id="article-18a-6">
                  <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                     <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">6</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">A delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 18(2) shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or the Council within a period of two months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by two months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.</Addition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
            </P1para>
         </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18b" id="article-18b" RestrictStartDate="2019-07-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
            <Pnumber>
               <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 18b</Addition>
            </Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18b/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18b/1" id="article-18b-1">
                  <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                     <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">Delegated acts adopted under this Article shall enter into force without delay and shall apply as long as no objection is expressed in accordance with paragraph 2. The notification of a delegated act to the European Parliament and the Council shall state the reasons for the use of the urgency procedure.</Addition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2009/148/article/18b/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2009/148/article/18b/2" id="article-18b-2">
                  <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                     <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Addition ChangeId="O001001M003" CommentaryRef="c000003">Either the European Parliament or the Council may object to a delegated act in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 18a(6). In such a case, the Commission shall repeal the act immediately following the notification of the decision to object by the European Parliament or by the Council.</Addition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
            </P1para>
         </P1></EUBody></EURetained></Legislation><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000003">
         <Para>
            <Text>Inserted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2019" Number="1243" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2019/1243" Title="Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)">Regulation (EU) 2019/1243 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 June 2019 adapting a number of legal acts providing for the use of the regulatory procedure with scrutiny to Articles 290 and 291 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eudr_2012_27/9721d407de.xml:
<Legislation><EUChapter DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/chapter/II" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/chapter/II" NumberOfProvisions="17" id="chapter-II" RestrictStartDate="2020-10-26" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I."><P1group RestrictStartDate="2018-12-24" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Energy efficiency obligation schemes</Addition>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7a" id="article-7a">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 7a</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/1" id="article-7a-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Where Member States decide to fulfil their obligations to achieve the amount of savings required under Article 7(1) by way of an energy efficiency obligation scheme, they shall ensure that obligated parties as referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article operating in each Member State's territory achieve, without prejudice to Article 7(4) and (5), their cumulative end-use energy savings requirement as set out in Article 7(1).</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Where applicable, Member States may decide that obligated parties fulfil those savings, in whole or in part, as a contribution to the Energy Efficiency National Fund in accordance with Article 20(6).</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/2" id="article-7a-2">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Member States shall designate, on the basis of objective and non-discriminatory criteria, obligated parties among energy distributors, retail energy sales companies and transport fuel distributors or transport fuel retailers operating in their territory. The amount of energy savings needed to fulfil the obligation shall be achieved by the obligated parties among final customers, designated by the Member State, independently of the calculation made pursuant to Article 7(1) or, if Member States so decide, through certified savings stemming from other parties as described in point (a) of paragraph 6 of this Article.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/3" id="article-7a-3">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">3</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Where retail energy sales companies are designated as obligated parties under paragraph 2, Member States shall ensure that, in fulfilling their obligation, retail energy sales companies do not create any barriers that impede consumers from switching from one supplier to another.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/4" id="article-7a-4">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">4</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Member States shall express the amount of energy savings required of each obligated party in terms of either final or primary energy consumption. The method chosen to express the amount of energy savings required shall also be used to calculate the savings claimed by obligated parties. The conversion factors set out in Annex IV shall apply.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/5" id="article-7a-5">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">5</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Member States shall put in place measurement, control and verification systems under which documented verification is carried out on at least a statistically significant proportion and representative sample of the energy efficiency improvement measures put in place by the obligated parties. The measurement, control and verification shall be carried out independently of the obligated parties.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/6" id="article-7a-6">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">6</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Within the energy efficiency obligation scheme, Member States may do one or both of the following:</Addition>
                           </Text>
                           <P3>
                              <Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">
                                 <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">a</Addition>
                              </Pnumber>
                              <P3para>
                                 <Text>
                                    <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">permit obligated parties to count towards their obligation certified energy savings achieved by energy service providers or other third parties, including when obligated parties promote measures through other State-approved bodies or through public authorities that may involve formal partnerships and may be in combination with other sources of finance. Where Member States so permit, they shall ensure that the certification of energy savings follows an approval process that is put in place in the Member States, that is clear, transparent, and open to all market participants, and that aims to minimise the costs of certification;</Addition>
                                 </Text>
                              </P3para>
                           </P3>
                           <P3>
                              <Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">
                                 <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">b</Addition>
                              </Pnumber>
                              <P3para>
                                 <Text>
                                    <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">allow obligated parties to count savings obtained in a given year as if they had instead been obtained in any of the four previous or three following years as long as this is not beyond the end of the obligation periods set out in Article 7(1).</Addition>
                                 </Text>
                              </P3para>
                           </P3>
                        </P2para>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Member States shall assess and, if appropriate, take measures to minimise the impact of the direct and indirect costs of energy efficiency obligation schemes on the competitiveness of energy-intensive industries exposed to international competition.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7a/7" id="article-7a-7">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">7</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Member States shall, on an annual basis, publish the energy savings achieved by each obligated party, or each sub-category of obligated party, and in total under the scheme.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2018-12-24" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I.">
               <Title>
                  <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Alternative policy measures</Addition>
               </Title>
               <P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7b" id="article-7b">
                  <Pnumber>
                     <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Article 7b</Addition>
                  </Pnumber>
                  <P1para>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7b/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7b/1" id="article-7b-1">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">1</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">Where Member States decide to fulfil their obligations to achieve the savings required under Article 7(1) by way of alternative policy measures, they shall ensure, without prejudice to Article 7(4) and (5), that the energy savings required under Article 7(1) are achieved among final customers.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                     <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2012/27/article/7b/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2012/27/article/7b/2" id="article-7b-2">
                        <Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                           <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">2</Addition>
                        </Pnumber>
                        <P2para>
                           <Text>
                              <Addition ChangeId="O003001M004" CommentaryRef="c000003">For all measures other than those relating to taxation, Member States shall put in place measurement, control and verification systems under which documented verification is carried out on at least a statistically significant proportion and representative sample of the energy efficiency improvement measures put in place by the participating or entrusted parties. The measurement, control and verification shall be carried out independently of the participating or entrusted parties.</Addition>
                           </Text>
                        </P2para>
                     </P2>
                  </P1para>
               </P1>
            </P1group></EUChapter><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000003">
         <Para>
            <Text>Inserted by <Citation Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2018" Number="2002" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eudr/2018/2002" Title="Directive (EU) 2018/2002 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 December 2018 amending Directive 2012/27/EU on energy efficiency (Text with EEA relevance)">Directive (EU) 2018/2002 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 December 2018 amending Directive 2012/27/EU on energy efficiency (Text with EEA relevance)</Citation>.</Text>
         </Para>
      </Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eur_2006_1013/8fa7828c24.xml: CHAPTER 6<Strong><Emphasis>Shipments <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>... with transit via third countries</Emphasis></Strong>Shipments of waste destined for disposalArticle 31Where a shipment of waste takes place within the United Kingdom with transit via one or more third countries, and the waste is destined for disposal, the competent authority of dispatch shall, in addition to the provisions of this Title, ask the competent authority in the third countries whether it wishes to send its written consent to the planned shipment:in the case of Parties to the Basel Convention, within 60 days, unless it has waived this right in accordance with the terms of that Convention; orin the case of countries not Parties to the Basel Convention, within a period agreed between the competent authorities.Shipments of waste destined for recoveryArticle 321When a shipment of waste takes place within the United Kingdom with transit via one or more non-EU countries to which the OECD Decision does not apply, and the waste is destined for recovery, Article 31 shall apply.2When a shipment of waste takes place within the United Kingdom, with transit via one or more non-EU countries to which the OECD Decision applies, and the waste is destined for recovery, the consent referred to in Article 9 may be provided tacitly, and if no objection has been lodged or no conditions have been specified, the shipment may start 30 days after the date of transmission of the acknowledgement by the competent authority of destination in accordance with Article 8.

UK_eur_2006_1013/a8afd04f34.xml: TITLE VITRANSIT THROUGH THE <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1643626611303" CommentaryRef="key-E">UNITED KINGDOM</Substitution> FROM AND TO THIRD COUNTRIESCHAPTER 1<Strong><Emphasis>Transit of waste for disposal</Emphasis></Strong>Transit through the <Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1643801260330" CommentaryRef="key-E2">United Kingdom</Substitution> of waste destined for disposalArticle 47Where waste destined for disposal is shipped through the United Kingdom from and to third countries, Article 42 shall apply mutatis mutandis...(a). . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .(b). . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . CHAPTER 2<Strong><Emphasis>Transit of waste for recovery</Emphasis></Strong>Transit through the <Substitution ChangeId="key-E5-1643802274389" CommentaryRef="key-E5">United Kingdom</Substitution> of waste destined for recoveryArticle 481Where waste destined for recovery is shipped through the United Kingdom from and to a non-EU country to which the OECD Decision does not apply, Article 47 shall apply mutatis mutandis.2Where waste destined for recovery is shipped through the United Kingdom from and to an EU country or a country to which the OECD Decision applies, Article 44 shall apply mutatis mutandis...a. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .b. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .3Where waste destined for recovery is shipped through the United Kingdom from a non-EU country to which the OECD Decision does not apply to an EU country or country to which the OECD Decision applies or vice versa, paragraph 1 shall apply as regards the non-EU country to which the OECD Decision does not apply and paragraph 2 shall apply as regards the EU country or country to which the OECD Decision applies.Words in Title 6 heading substituted (31.12.2020) by The International Waste Shipments (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/590), regs. 2(2), 87; 2020 c. 1, Sch. 5 para. 1(1)

RestrictStartDate="2020-12-31"><Title>Reporting by <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1725638901000" CommentaryRef="key-E">appropriate authorities</Substitution></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2006/166/article/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2006/166/article/7" id="article-7"><Pnumber>Article 7</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2006/166/article/7/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2006/166/article/7/1" id="article-7-1"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1725638919360" CommentaryRef="key-E">appropriate authorities</Substitution> shall determine, having regard to the requirements set out in paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article, a date by which operators shall provide all the data referred to in Article 5(1) and (2) and the information referred to in Article 5(3), (4) and (5) to its competent authority.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2006/166/article/7/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2006/166/article/7/2" id="article-7-2"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter="."><Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1725638901002" CommentaryRef="key-E2">2</Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1725638901002" CommentaryRef="key-E2">Appropriate authorities outside England and the competent authority in England must provide, each year, to the Secretary of State a report containing all the data referred to in Article 5(1) and (2) in the format and by the dates set out in Decision (EU) 2019/1741. This information shall include the chemical composition of mixtures placed on the market and classified as hazardous on the basis of their health or physical effects, including the chemical identity of substances in mixtures for which a request for use of an alternative chemical name has been accepted by the Agency, in accordance with Article 24.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2008/1272/article/45/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2008/1272/article/45/1" id="article-45-1"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter="."><Addition ChangeId="key-E5-1644242298361" CommentaryRef="key-E5">1A</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E5-1644242298361" CommentaryRef="key-E5">The Secretary of State may carry out the function set out in paragraph 1 in relation to  Scotland or Wales, if the Devolved Authority in question has consented to the Secretary of State exercising that function.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2008/1272/article/45/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2008/1272/article/45/2" id="article-45-2"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The appointed bodies shall provide all requisite guarantees for maintaining the confidentiality of the information received. Such information may only be used:</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2008/1272/article/45/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2008/1272/article/45/2/a" id="article-45-2-a"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to meet medical demand by formulating preventative and curative measures, in particular in the event of an emergency;</Text></P3para><P3para><Text>and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2008/1272/article/45/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2008/1272/article/45/2/b" id="article-45-2-b"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>where requested by the  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E6-1644242410471" CommentaryRef="key-E6">Secretary of State or the relevant Devolved Authority</Substitution>, to undertake statistical analysis to identify where improved risk management measures may be needed.</Text></P3para></P3><Text>The information shall not be used for other purposes.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2008/1272/article/45/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2008/1272/article/45/3" id="article-45-3"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" accordance with regulations made under Article 45(4), to carry out the tasks for which the appointed bodies are responsible.</Substitution></Text></P2para></P2><P2 <Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2012/965/article/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2012/965/article/1" id="article-1"><Pnumber><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001">
                  Article 1
               </Substitution></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2012/965/article/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2012/965/article/1/1" id="article-1-1"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">1</Substitution></Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">
                           This Regulation lays down detailed rules for air operations with aeroplanes and helicopters, including ramp inspections of aircraft of operators under the safety oversight of another State when landed at aerodromes located in the  </Substitution></Substitution><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1666708240777" CommentaryRef="key-E2">United Kingdom</Substitution></Substitution></Substitution><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">.
                        </Substitution></Substitution></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2012/965/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2012/965/article/1/2" id="article-1-2"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter="."><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">
                        2</Substitution></Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">
                           This Regulation also lays down detailed rules on the conditions for issuing, maintaining, amending, limiting, suspending or revoking the certificates of operators of aircraft referred to in points (b)(i) and (ii) of Article 2(1) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1139, except for balloons and sailplanes, engaged in commercial air transport operation, the privileges and responsibilities of the holders of certificates as well as conditions under which operations shall be prohibited, limited or subject to certain conditions in the interest of safety;
                        </Substitution></Substitution></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2012/965/article/1/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2012/965/article/1/3" id="article-1-3"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter="."><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">
                        3</Substitution></Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M001" CommentaryRef="c000002">
                           This Regulation also lays down detailed rules on the conditions and procedures for the declaration by operators engaged in commercial specialised operations of aeroplanes and helicopters or in non-commercial operation of complex motor-powered aircraft, including non-commercial specialised operations of complex motor-powered aircraft, of their capability and the availability of the means to discharge the responsibilities associated with the operation of aircraft, and for the oversight of such operators.</Substitution></Substitution>
                        </Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2012/965/article/1/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2012/965/article/1/4" id="article-1-4"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter="."><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001">
                        4</Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001">
                           This Regulation also lays down detailed rules on the conditions under which certain high risk commercial specialised operations shall be subject to authorisation in the interest of safety, and on the conditions for issuing, maintaining, amending, limiting, suspending or revoking the authorisations.
                        </Substitution></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2012/965/article/1/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2012/965/article/1/5" id="article-1-5"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter="."><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001">
                        5</Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001">
                           This Regulation shall not apply to air operations within the scope of Article 1(2)(a) of Regulation (EC) No 216/2008.
                        </Substitution></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2012/965/article/1/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2012/965/article/1/6" id="article-1-6"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O013001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">6</Substitution></Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O013001M002" CommentaryRef="c000003">
                           This Regulation shall not apply to air operations with airships.</Substitution></Substitution>
                        </Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2012/965/article/1/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2012/965/article/1/7" id="article-1-7"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">
                        <Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M002" CommentaryRef="c000002">7</Substitution></Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="O003001M001" CommentaryRef="c000001"><Substitution ChangeId="O014001M002" CommentaryRef="c000002">
                           This Regulation shall not apply to air operations with balloons and sailplanes. However, in respect of such air operations with balloons, other than tethered gas balloons, and sailplanes, the requirements in respect of oversight of Article 3 shall apply.</Substitution></Substitution>
                        </Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary Type="F" Source="EU" id="c000002"><Para><Text>Substituted by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1975" id="cc00002" Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2018" Number="1975" Title="Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/1975 of 14 December 2018 amending Regulation (EU) No 965/2012 as regards air operations requirements for sailplanes and electronic flight bags">Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/1975 of 14 December 2018 amending Regulation (EU) No 965/2012 as regards air operations requirements for sailplanes and electronic flight bags</Citation>.</Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_eur_2014_165/01e82db65e.xml: CHAPTER VIII<Strong>FINAL PROVISIONS</Strong>CommitteeArticle 42. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .Tachograph ForumArticle 43. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .Communication of national measuresArticle 44. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .Amendment of Regulation (EC) No 561/2006Article 45Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 is hereby amended as follows:in Article 3, the following point is inserted after point (a):vehicles or combinations of vehicles with a maximum permissible mass not exceeding 7,5 tonnes used for carrying materials, equipment or machinery for the driver’s use in the course of his work, and which are used only within a 100 km radius from the base of the undertaking and on the condition that driving the vehicle does not constitute the driver’s main activity;;Article 13(1) is amended as follows:in points (d), (f) and (p), the words ‘50 kilometre’ or ‘50 km’ are replaced by the words ‘100 km’;the first subparagraph of point (d) is replaced by the following:vehicles or combinations of vehicles with a maximum permissible mass not exceeding 7,5 tonnes used by universal service providers as defined in Article 2(13) of Directive 97/67/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 15 December 1997 on common rules for the development of the internal market of Community postal services and the improvement of quality of service to deliver items as part of the universal service..Transitional measuresArticle 46. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .RepealArticle 47Regulation (EEC) No 3821/85 is hereby repealed. References to the repealed Regulation shall be construed as references to this Regulation.Entry into forceArticle 48This Regulation shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.It shall, subject to the transitional measures in Article 46, apply with effect from 2 March 2016. However, Articles 24, 34 and 45 shall apply with effect from 2 March 2015.

That certificate shall cover the aerodrome and its safety-related equipment, unless that safety-related equipment is covered by a declaration or certificate referred to in points (a) and (b) respectively of Article 35(1).</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/2" id="article-34-2"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The certificate referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be issued upon application, when the applicant has demonstrated that the aerodrome:</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/2/a" id="article-34-2-a"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>complies with the  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1675854214556" CommentaryRef="key-E">regulations</Substitution>  referred to in Article 36 and with the aerodrome certification basis set out in paragraph 5 of this Article; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/2/b" id="article-34-2-b"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>has no feature or characteristic making it unsafe for operation.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/3" id="article-34-3"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The certificate referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article may be amended to include changes to the aerodrome or its safety-related equipment, in accordance with the  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1675854234998" CommentaryRef="key-E">regulations</Substitution>  referred to in point (c) of Article 36(1).</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/4" id="article-34-4"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The certificate referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article may be limited, suspended or revoked when the aerodrome or its safety-related equipment no longer complies with the rules and procedures for issuing and maintaining such certificate, in accordance with the  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1675854253163" CommentaryRef="key-E">regulations</Substitution>  referred to in point (c) of Article 36(1).</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/5" id="article-34-5"><Pnumber PuncBefore="" PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The certification basis for an aerodrome shall consist of the following:</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/5/a" id="article-34-5-a"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the applicable certification specifications related to the type of aerodromes;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/5/b" id="article-34-5-b"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")">b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>those provisions of the applicable certification specifications for which an equivalent level of safety has been accepted;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/34/5/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/34/5/c" id="article-34-5-c"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" certification specifications referred to in point (a) of this paragraph inadequate or inappropriate to ensure conformity with the essential requirements referred to in Article 33.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Word in <CitationSubRef id="cvhtdpid4-00006" SectionRef="article-34"
