relevant for determining whether the person complies with this Regulation and with  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1676294880467" CommentaryRef="key-E2">regulations made under it</Substitution>;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/83/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/83/2/c" id="article-83-2-c"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" PuncAfter=")"><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2018/1139/article/83/2/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/eur/2018/1139/article/83/2/d" id="article-83-2-d"><Pnumber PuncBefore="(" information in question is stored.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para><P2para><Text>The  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E4-1676294952636" CommentaryRef="key-E4">CAA</Substitution>  shall, where required for ChangeId="d29p2639" CommentaryRef="c21340511">A customs officer may, for the purpose of facilitating the exercise or performance by any enforcing authority or inspector of any of the powers or duties of the authority or inspector under any of the relevant statutory provisions, seize any imported article or imported substance and detain it for not more than two working days.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1978/1039/article/27A/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1978/1039/article/27A/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1978/1039/article/34/1" id="article-34-1" RestrictStartDate="2016-10-21"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="c22013651"/><CommentaryRef Ref="c22510381"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where the commission by any person of an offence under any of the relevant statutory provisions is due to the act or default of some other person, that other person shall be guilty of an offence, and a person may be charged with and convicted of the offence under this paragraph whether or not proceedings are taken against the first-mentioned person.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1978/1039/article/34/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1978/1039/article/34/2" id="article-34-2" RestrictStartDate="2016-10-21"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="c22013661"/><CommentaryRef Ref="c22510381"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where there would be or have been the commission of an offence under Article 31 by the Crown but for the circumstance that that Article does not bind the Crown, and that fact is due to the act or default of a person other than the Crown, that person shall be guilty of the offence which, but for that circumstance, the Crown would be committing or would have committed, and may be charged with and convicted of that offence accordingly.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1978/1039/article/34/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1978/1039/article/34/3" id="article-34-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The provisions of this Article are subject to any provision made under Article 17(6).</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_nisi_1979_1709/5d4610b445.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15/1" id="article-15-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Subject to this Article<Addition ChangeId="d29p1371" CommentaryRef="c11614111"> and Article 15A</Addition> if, in relation to any particular building or any class of building, it appears to the Department that it is unreasonable that any provision of the building regulations (being a provision which apart from this Article applies, or by reason of a proposed change of use will apply, to that building or class of building) should apply to the building or class of building, or should so apply without relaxation, the Department may—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15/1/a" id="article-15-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the case of a particular building, on an application made to it in that behalf give a direction dispensing with or relaxing that provision in relation to that building;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15/1/b" id="article-15-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the case of a class of building, either on an application made to it in that behalf or of its own accord and in either case after consultation with the Advisory Committee give a direction dispensing with or relaxing that provision generally in relation to that class of building.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="c11614111" Type="F"><Para><Text><Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1990" id="c00131" Class="NorthernIrelandOrderInCouncil" Year="1990" AlternativeNumber="14">1990 NI 14</Citation></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_nisi_1979_1709/d771b1e5ae.xml: <Legislation><P1group RestrictStartDate="2006-01-01"><Title><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">Relaxation of building regulations for existing work</Addition></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A" id="article-15A"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">15A</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/1" id="article-15A-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">This Article applies to a direction under Article 15(1)(a) that will affect the application of building regulations to work that has been carried out before the giving of the direction.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/2" id="article-15A-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">Neither the Department nor a district council shall give a direction to which this Article applies if, when the application is made, there is in force an injunction or other direction given by a court that requires the work to be pulled down, removed or altered.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/3" id="article-15A-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">Subject to paragraph (8), after the making of an application for a direction to which this Article applies, and until the application is withdrawn or finally disposed of, no contravention notice shall be served as regards the work to which the application relates on the ground that it contravenes the requirement to which the application relates.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/4" id="article-15A-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">If an application for a direction to which this Article applies is made before the expiration of 18 months from the date of completion of the work to which the application relates, Article 18(5) shall not prevent the service of a contravention notice as regards that work at any time within a period of 3 months from the date on which the application is withdrawn or finally disposed of.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/5" id="article-15A-5"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">5</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">Subject to paragraph (8), if an application for a direction to which this Article applies is made after a contravention notice has been served on the ground that the work to which the application relates contravenes the requirement to which the application relates (not being an application prohibited by paragraph (2)), Article 18(4) shall have effect in relation to that work as if for the reference to the period there mentioned there were substituted a reference to a period expiring 28 days after the application is withdrawn or finally disposed of.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/6" id="article-15A-6"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">6</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">Subject to paragraph (8), if an application for a direction to which this Article applies is made after any person has, in consequence of the carrying out of the work to which the application relates in contravention of building regulations, become liable to a fine continuing from day to day, the daily fine shall not be recoverable in respect of any day after the making of the application and before it is withdrawn or finally disposed of.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/7" id="article-15A-7"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">7</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">In a case where an application is withdrawn or is finally disposed of without any direction being given, the Department or, as the case may be, the district council may order that the daily fine shall not be recoverable in respect of any day during such further period not exceeding 28 days as may be specified in the order.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1979/1709/article/15A/8" id="article-15A-8"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">8</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p1458" CommentaryRef="c11613831">Paragraphs (3), (5) and (6) do not apply to an application that is a repetition, or substantially a repetition, of a previous application under Article 15(1)(a).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 <Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90" id="article-90"><Pnumber>90</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1" id="article-90-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">A person to whom this paragraph applies shall not—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1/a" id="article-90-1-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">print or publish, or cause or procure to be printed or published, in a newspaper or periodical, or</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1/b" id="article-90-1-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">include, or cause or procure to be included, in a programme included in a programme service (within the meaning of the Broadcasting Act 1990) for reception in Northern Ireland,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">
any particulars of any domestic proceedings other than such particulars as are mentioned in paragraph (1A) below.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1A" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1A" id="article-90-1A"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">1A</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">The particulars referred to in paragraph (1) above are—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1A/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1A/a" id="article-90-1A-a"><Pnumber><Addition DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1A/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1A/c" id="article-90-1A-c"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5329" CommentaryRef="c16970331">Paragraph (1) above applies—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/1B/a" newspaper.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/2" imprisonment for a term not exceeding four months or to a fine not exceeding<Addition ChangeId="d29p5405" CommentaryRef="c16970351"> level 3 on the standard scale</Addition>, or to both.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/3" id="article-90-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A prosecution for an offence under this Article shall not be instituted otherwise than by or with the consent of the Attorney General.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/4" id="article-90-4"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="c16970371"/>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For the purposes of Article 7(2) of the Prosecution of Offences (Northern Ireland) Order 1972, paragraph (3) shall be deemed to be a relevant consent provision passed before 30th March 1972.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/90/5" id="article-90-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Nothing in this Article shall apply to the printing or publishing of any matter in any newspaper or periodical of a technical character bona fide intended for circulation among members of the legal or medical profession.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary id="c16970331" Type="F"><Para><Text><Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/42" id="c00631" Year="1990" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Number="42">1990 c. UK_nisi_1981_1675/24ab083ed5.xml: PART 3<Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1503311041962" CommentaryRef="key-E">THE HOLDING OF PETTY SESSIONS</Substitution><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1503309228519" CommentaryRef="key-E">Petty sessions</Substitution>111Sessions for the holding of courts of summary jurisdiction shall continue to be known as petty sessions and are so referred to in this Order.2The Lord Chief Justice may give directions as to—athe places at which petty sessions are to be held;bthe days on which petty sessions are to be regularly held;cthe ordinary hours of sitting of courts of summary jurisdiction;dsuch other incidental, consequential, transitional or supplementary matters as appear to the Lord Chief Justice to be necessary or proper.Holding of petty sessions in courthouse12Where a courthouse is provided or maintained under the Administration of Justice Act (Northern Ireland) 1954 at any place fixed for the holding of petty sessions, the petty sessions shall be held in that courthouse unless either—atheLord Chief Justice otherwise directs; orbthe resident magistrate presiding or who is to preside otherwise adjourns the sitting of the court pursuant to the powers conferred on him by section 13 of that Act.Art. 11 and Pt. 3 heading substituted (31.10.2016) by Justice Act (Northern Ireland) 2015 (c. 9), s. 106(2), Sch. 1 para. 86(4) (with Sch. 8 para. 1); S.R. 2016/387, art. 2(k) (with art. 3)

period of limitation is provided for by any other enactment—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/1/a" id="article-19-1-a" RestrictStartDate="2022-02-11"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="c20289671"/><CommentaryRef Ref="c21084261"/><CommentaryRef Ref="c22031331"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E12"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E13"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E14"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E15"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E16"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E17"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E18"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E19"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E20"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E21"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E22"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E23"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E24"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E25"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E26"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E27"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E28"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E29"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E30"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E31"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E32"/>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>a magistrates' court shall not have jurisdiction to hear and determine a complaint charging the commission of a summary offence other than an offence which is also triable upon indictment unless the complaint was made within six months from the time when the offence was committed or ceased to continue; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/1/b" id="article-19-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>a complaint charging the commission of an indictable offence may be made to a justice of the peace and dealt with at any time and, accordingly, a resident magistrate may at any time after an indictable offence was alleged to have been committed exercise any jurisdiction conferred on him by Articles 45 and 46 or by any other enactment to try that offence summarily.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/2" id="article-19-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Subject to paragraph (4), a complaint charging the commission of an offence which is both punishable upon summary conviction or triable upon indictment may be made and dealt with at any time and, accordingly, nothing in any other enactment (however framed or worded) which, as regards any offence to which it applies, would but for this Article impose a time-limit on the power of a magistrates' court to hear and determine a complaint charging the commission of a summary offence or impose a limitation on the time for taking summary proceedings shall apply in relation to any offence which is both punishable upon summary conviction or triable upon indictment.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/3" id="article-19-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (2), that paragraph includes enactments which impose a time-limit that applies only in certain circumstances (for example where the proceedings are not instituted by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions for Northern Ireland or some other specified authority).</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1981/1675/article/19/4" id="article-19-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where as regards any indictable offence there is imposed by any enactment (however framed or worded and whether falling within paragraph (2) or not) a limitation on the time for taking proceedings on indictment for that offence no summary proceedings for that offence shall be taken after the latest time for taking proceedings on indictment.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

supplier (“the defaulting supplier”); and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 CommentaryRef="c21257011">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">A direction under this paragraph—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/article/24A/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1996/275/article/24A/2/a" id="article-24A-2-a"><Pnumber><Addition DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/article/24A/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1996/275/article/24A/2/b" id="article-24A-2-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">may include such other requirements or prohibitions as are, in the opinion of the Authority, reasonably incidental or to consequential upon the requirement to supply.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/3n1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/3n1" CommentaryRef="c21257011">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">A direction under paragraph (2) shall specify the terms and conditions under which the designated supplier shall supply gas to any other customer to which the direction relates, including in particular the terms and conditions in relation to—</Addition></Text><P3 ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">the termination of supply; and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/article/24A/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1996/275/article/24A/3/b" id="article-24A-3-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">the method for calculating the charges for supply:</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">and may specify the terms and conditions under which the designated supplier shall do anything else in pursuance of the direction.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/4n1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/4n1" id="part-II-crossheading-consumer-protection-miscellaneous_article-24A-4n1" shortId="article-24A-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">A direction under paragraph (2) may also modify the supply licence of the designated supplier or the conditions included in that licence where it is necessary or expedient for the purposes of ensuring that the supplier can comply with any requirement or prohibition under that direction.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/5n1" send a notice to those customers of the defaulting supplier to which the direction relates giving such particulars and containing such information as the Authority may specify in the direction.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/6n1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/6n1" CommentaryRef="c21257011">6</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">Where the customer is supplied by gas by a designated supplier in pursuance of a direction under paragraph (2), a contract for the supply of gas shall be deemed to exist between the customer and the designated supplier from the date on which the supply of gas commenced to the date the direction ceases to have effect.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/7n1" CommentaryRef="c21257011">7</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5814" CommentaryRef="c21257011">A direction under paragraph (2) may be made subject to such conditions as the Authority may specify in the directions.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/1996/275/part/II/crossheading/consumer-protection-miscellaneous/article/24A/8n1" Ireland) Order 2006.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2007-04-01"><Title><Addition ChangeId="d29p878" CommentaryRef="c19584471">Emergency supply by DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1254/article/16B/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1254/article/16B/2" id="article-16B-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p878" under paragraph (1).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1254/article/16B/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1254/article/16B/4" id="article-16B-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p878" CommentaryRef="c19584471">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p878" CommentaryRef="c19584471">A water undertaker commits DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1254/article/16B/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1254/article/16B/5" id="article-16B-5"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p878" CommentaryRef="c19584471">5</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p878" CommentaryRef="c19584471">A water undertaker guilty of an offence under paragraph (4) shall be liable on UK_nisi_2006_3336/57889ce49d.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6" id="article-161-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Without limiting the terms which may be included in an agreement under this Article—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/a" id="article-161-6-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>such terms may include terms as to the provision of such security as the undertaker may reasonably require for the discharge of any obligations imposed on the other party to the agreement; <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>...</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b" id="article-161-6-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>such terms relating to a drain may include in particular —</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/i" id="article-161-6-b-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>identification of that part of the drain which constitutes the lateral drain for the purposes of the agreement and, in particular, the point or points of connection between that part and the remainder of the drain;</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/ii" id="article-161-6-b-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>a requirement for the installation of an inspection chamber, at the expense of the person with whom the sewerage undertaker is to make the agreement, at a place specified in the agreement;</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/iii" id="article-161-6-b-iii"><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>provision, if the inspection chamber is constructed in accordance with the terms of the agreement, for the undertaker to declare that the inspection chamber be vested in the undertaker at the same time as the lateral drain; and</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/iv" id="article-161-6-b-iv"><Pnumber>iv</Pnumber><P4para><Text>provision for the lateral drain, once vested in the undertaker, to communicate with a public sewer at the place or places specified in the agreement<Addition ChangeId="key-E-1515426795543" CommentaryRef="key-E">; and</Addition></Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/c" id="article-161-6-c"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1515426795543" CommentaryRef="key-E">c</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1515426795543" CommentaryRef="key-E">an agreement relating to a sewer or drain may include terms requiring the other party to construct one or more sustainable drainage systems designed to receive surface water from any premises served by that sewer or drain.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Art. 161(6)(c) inserted and preceding word inserted (24.5.2016 with application as mentioned in s. 8(1) of the amending Act) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7" id="ctsmjfo02-00072" Class="NorthernIrelandAct" Year="2016" Number="7" Title="Water and Sewerage Services Act (Northern Ireland) 2016">Water and Sewerage Services Act (Northern Ireland) 2016 (c. 7)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ctsmjfo02-00073" CitationRef="ctsmjfo02-00072" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7/section/4/5" SectionRef="section-4-5" Operative="true">ss. 4(5)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef id="ctsmjfo02-00074" CitationRef="ctsmjfo02-00072" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7/section/8" SectionRef="section-8">8</CitationSubRef></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_nisi_2006_3336/9700c0b679.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5" id="article-21-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of the Authority, for the purpose of assisting the <Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1481293533744" CommentaryRef="key-E2">CMA</Substitution> in carrying out an investigation on a reference under this Article or in carrying out functions under Article 26, to give to <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481293657581" CommentaryRef="key-E">the CMA</Substitution>—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5/a" id="article-21-5-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any information in the Authority's possession which relates to matters falling within the scope of the investigation or the carrying out of those functions, and which is either—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5/a/i" id="article-21-5-a-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>requested by <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481293727305" CommentaryRef="key-E">the CMA</Substitution> for that purpose; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5/a/ii" id="article-21-5-a-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>information which, in the Authority's opinion, it would be appropriate for that purpose to give to <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481293787450" CommentaryRef="key-E">the CMA</Substitution> without any such request; and</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/21/5/b" id="article-21-5-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any other assistance which <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481293834876" CommentaryRef="key-E">the CMA</Substitution> may require, and which it is within the Authority's power to give, in relation to any such matters;</Text></P3para></P3><Text>and <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481293927048" CommentaryRef="key-E">the CMA</Substitution>, for the purpose of carrying out any such investigation or such functions, shall take account of any information given to them for that purpose under this paragraph.</Text></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in art. 21(5) substituted (1.4.2014) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24" id="ce44kr1r2-00091" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="2013" Number="24" Title="Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013">Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 (c. 24)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ce44kr1r2-00092" CitationRef="ce44kr1r2-00091" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24/section/103/3" SectionRef="section-103-3">s. 103(3)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef id="ce44kr1r2-00093" CitationRef="ce44kr1r2-00091" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24/schedule/6/paragraph/184/5/b" SectionRef="schedule-6-paragraph-184-5-b" Operative="true">Sch. 6 para. 184(5)(b)</CitationSubRef>; <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416" id="ce44kr1r2-00094" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument" Year="2014" Number="416" Title="The Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 (Commencement No. 6, Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 2014">S.I. 2014/416</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ce44kr1r2-00095" CitationRef="ce44kr1r2-00094" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/d" SectionRef="article-2-1-d">art. 2(1)(d)</CitationSubRef> (with <CitationSubRef id="ce44kr1r2-00096" CitationRef="ce44kr1r2-00094" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/schedule" SectionRef="schedule">Sch.</CitationSubRef>)</Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_nisi_2006_3336/c2ca5e0c14.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/19/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/19/4" id="article-19-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For the purposes of paragraph (3), where—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/19/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/19/4/a" id="article-19-4-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the question or matter referred to the <Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1481284561018" CommentaryRef="key-E2">CMA</Substitution> concerns the review of a price control imposed on the company holding the appointment; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/19/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/19/4/b" id="article-19-4-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481284670199" CommentaryRef="key-E">the CMA</Substitution> is to decide to what extent it is reasonable to take into account in its determination costs incurred or borne by the company in connection with the reference,</Text></P3para></P3><Text><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481284730330" CommentaryRef="key-E">the CMA</Substitution> shall also have regard to the extent to which, in its view, its determination is likely to support the company's (rather than the Authority's) claims in relation to the question or matter referred to it.</Text></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in <CitationSubRef id="ce3z3asu2-00078" SectionRef="article-19-4" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/19/4">art. 19(4)</CitationSubRef> substituted (1.4.2014) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24" id="ce3z3asu2-00079" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="2013" Number="24" Title="Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013">Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 (c. 24)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ce3z3asu2-00080" CitationRef="ce3z3asu2-00079" SectionRef="section-103-3" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24/section/103/3">s. 103(3)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef id="ce3z3asu2-00081" CitationRef="ce3z3asu2-00079" SectionRef="schedule-6-paragraph-183-4-b" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24/schedule/6/paragraph/183/4/b" Operative="true">Sch. 6 para. 183(4)(b)</CitationSubRef>; <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416" id="ce3z3asu2-00082" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument" Year="2014" Number="416" Title="The Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 (Commencement No. 6, Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 2014">S.I. 2014/416</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ce3z3asu2-00083" CitationRef="ce3z3asu2-00082" SectionRef="article-2-1-d" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/d">art. 2(1)(d)</CitationSubRef> (with <CitationSubRef id="ce3z3asu2-00084" CitationRef="ce3z3asu2-00082" SectionRef="schedule" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/schedule">Sch.</CitationSubRef>)</Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_nisi_2006_3336/c34486efd5.xml: <Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/24" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/24" id="article-24"><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/6" id="article-24-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The first consideration is the need to exclude from disclosure (so far as practicable) any information whose disclosure the <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481539985187" CommentaryRef="key-E">CMA</Substitution> thinks is contrary to the public interest.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/7" id="article-24-7"><P2para><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/7/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/7/a" id="article-24-7-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>commercial information whose disclosure the <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481540097017" CommentaryRef="key-E">CMA</Substitution> thinks might significantly harm the legitimate business interests of the undertaking to which it relates; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/7/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/7/b" id="article-24-7-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>information relating to the private affairs of an individual whose disclosure the <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1481540157019" CommentaryRef="key-E">CMA</Substitution> thinks might significantly harm the individual's interests.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in <CitationSubRef id="ce8757pz2-00045" SectionRef="article-24-6" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/6">art. 24(6)</CitationSubRef><CitationSubRef id="ce8757pz2-00046" SectionRef="article-24-7" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/24/7">(7)</CitationSubRef> substituted (1.4.2014) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24" id="ce8757pz2-00047" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="2013" Number="24" Title="Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013">Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 (c. 24)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ce8757pz2-00048" CitationRef="ce8757pz2-00047" SectionRef="section-103-3" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24/section/103/3">s. 103(3)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef id="ce8757pz2-00049" CitationRef="ce8757pz2-00047" SectionRef="schedule-6-paragraph-186-5" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2013/24/schedule/6/paragraph/186/5" Operative="true">Sch. 6 para. 186(5)</CitationSubRef>; <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416" id="ce8757pz2-00050" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument" Year="2014" Number="416" Title="The Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 (Commencement No. 6, Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 2014">S.I. 2014/416</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ce8757pz2-00051" CitationRef="ce8757pz2-00050" SectionRef="article-2-1-d" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/d">art. 2(1)(d)</CitationSubRef> (with <CitationSubRef id="ce8757pz2-00052" CitationRef="ce8757pz2-00050" SectionRef="schedule" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/schedule">Sch.</CitationSubRef>)</Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_nisr_1997_193/6c4446b3d1.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/193/regulation/16" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/193/regulation/16" id="regulation-16">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>16</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For the purpose of ensuring that no damage is caused to a pipeline, the operator shall take such steps to inform persons of its existence and whereabouts as are reasonable.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_nisr_1997_195/b13af3000f.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9" id="regulation-9">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1" id="regulation-9-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A person who prepares a safety case pursuant to these Regulations shall—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/a" id="regulation-9-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>ensure that when the safety case is sent to the Department for acceptance it is notified of an address in Northern Ireland for the purposes of sub-paragraphs (<Emphasis>b</Emphasis>) to (<Emphasis>d</Emphasis>) and (<Emphasis>f</Emphasis>) and (<Emphasis>g</Emphasis>);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/b" id="regulation-9-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>keep the accepted safety case and any revision thereof or a copy thereof at that address;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/c" id="regulation-9-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>keep each audit report made by him or a copy thereof at that address;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/d" id="regulation-9-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>ensure that a record is made of any action taken in consequence of such an audit report and keep that record or a copy thereof at that address;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/e" id="regulation-9-1-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>ensure that a report is made of every review carried out by him pursuant to regulation 4(3) and ensure that a copy is sent to the Department;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/f" id="regulation-9-1-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>keep such report or a copy thereof at that address; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/1/g" id="regulation-9-1-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>ensure that a record is made of every test carried out pursuant to regulation 8(5) in relation to gas he conveys and keep that record or a copy thereof at that address.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/2" id="regulation-9-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Each report and record required to be kept by paragraph (1) shall be kept for a period of three years after it has been made, and the safety case and revision shall be kept for so long as they are current.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/3" id="regulation-9-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>It shall be sufficient compliance with paragraph (1) for the information in the documents to be kept at the address notified on film or by electronic means if the information is capable of being reproduced as a written copy at that address and it is secure from loss or unauthorised interference.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/4" id="regulation-9-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person has notified an address pursuant to sub-paragraph (<Emphasis>a</Emphasis>) of paragraph (1), he may notify to the Department a different address in Northern Ireland for the purposes of the provisions referred to in that sub-paragraph, and where he does so references in those provisions and in paragraph (3) where applicable to the address notified shall be construed as the address in the last notification made under this paragraph.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/195/regulation/9/5" id="regulation-9-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this regulation “audit report” means a report made pursuant to the arrangements referred to in paragraph 11 of Schedule 1 or paragraph 4 of Schedule 2 (to the extent that the later mentioned paragraph relates to arrangements for audit).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_nisr_1997_248/8666c3c320.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1997/248/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1997/248/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to the provisions of Schedule 2, these Regulations shall apply to and in relation to the carriage of dangerous goods.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_nisr_2000_375/a68a08af2f.xml: <Legislation><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-10-20"><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/><Title>Information, instruction and training</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14" id="regulation-14"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>14</Pnumber><P1para><Text>Every employer shall ensure that—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/a" id="regulation-14-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>those of his employees who are engaged in work with ionising radiation are given appropriate training in the field of radiation protection and receive such information and instruction as is suitable and sufficient for them to know—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/a/i" id="regulation-14-a-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the risks to health created by exposure to ionising radiation;</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/a/ii" id="regulation-14-a-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the precautions which should be taken; and</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/a/iii" id="regulation-14-a-iii"><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the importance of complying with the medical, technical and administrative requirements of these Regulations;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/b" id="regulation-14-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>adequate information is given to other persons who are directly concerned with the work with ionising radiation carried on by the employer to ensure their health and safety so far as is reasonably practicable; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/c" id="regulation-14-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>those female employees of that employer who are engaged in work with ionising radiation are informed of the possible risk arising from ionising radiation to the foetus and to a nursing infant and of the importance of those employees informing the employer in writing as soon as possible—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/c/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/c/i" id="regulation-14-c-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>after becoming aware of their pregnancy; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/c/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/14/c/ii" id="regulation-14-c-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>if they are breast feeding.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></P1para></P1></P1group><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_nisr_2000_375/bb6492b16a.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/375/regulation/35/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/35/1" id="regulation-35-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Executive may, by a certificate in writing, approve (in accordance with such criteria as may from time to time be specified by the Executive) a suitable dosimetry service for such of the purposes of these Regulations <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1769587718421" CommentaryRef="key-E">or of the Radiation (Emergency Preparedness and Public Information) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2001</Addition>  as are specified in the certificate.</Text></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in <CitationSubRef id="c2jzv7fq6-00006" SectionRef="regulation-35-1" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/375/regulation/35/1">reg. 35(1)</CitationSubRef> inserted (4.2.2002) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2001/436" id="c2jzv7fq6-00007" Class="NorthernIrelandStatutoryRule" Year="2001" Number="436" Title="Radiation (Emergency Preparedness and Public Information) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2001 (revoked) 2001">Radiation (Emergency Preparedness and Public Information) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2001 (S.R. 2001/436)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c2jzv7fq6-00007" id="c2jzv7fq6-00008" SectionRef="regulation-1" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2001/436/regulation/1">reg. 1</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c2jzv7fq6-00007" id="c2jzv7fq6-00009" SectionRef="schedule-11-paragraph-3" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2001/436/schedule/11/paragraph/3" Operative="true">Sch. 11 para. 3</CitationSubRef></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

Safety at Work (Northern Ireland) Order 1978;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1790591921784" CommentaryRef="key-E2"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E3-1790600310203" CommentaryRef="key-E3">“CDG 2010” means the Carriage of Dangerous Goods and Use of Transportable Pressure Equipment Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2010</Substitution></Substitution><Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1790591921784" CommentaryRef="key-E2">;</Substitution> </Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“competent person” means a competent individual person (other than an employee) or a competent body of persons corporate or unincorporate; and accordingly any reference herein to a competent person performing a function includes a reference to his performing it through his employees;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“danger” in relation to a pressure system means reasonably foreseeable danger to persons from system failure, but (except in the case of steam) it does not mean danger from the hazardous characteristics of the relevant fluid other than from its pressure;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“examination” means a careful and critical scrutiny of a pressure system or part of a pressure system, in or out of service as appropriate, using suitable techniques, including testing where appropriate, to assess –</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha"><ListItem><Para><Text>its actual condition; and</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>whether, for the period up to the next examination, it will not cause danger when properly used if normal maintenance is carried out, and for this purpose “normal maintenance” means such maintenance as it is reasonable to expect the user (in the case of an installed system) or owner (in the case of a mobile system) to ensure is carried out independently of any advice from the competent person making the examination;</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“the Executive” means the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“installed system” means a pressure system other than a mobile system;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“maximum allowable pressure” and “minimum allowable pressure” mean the maximum pressure and minimum pressure respectively for which a pressure vessel is designed;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“mobile system” means a pressure system which can be readily moved between and used in different locations but it does not include a pressure system of a locomotive;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text> <Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1790592012494" CommentaryRef="key-E4">“old pressure receptacle” has the meaning  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1790592012494" CommentaryRef="key-E4"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E3-1790600438675" CommentaryRef="key-E3">assigned by regulation 11(6) of CDG 2010</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1790592012494" CommentaryRef="key-E4">  which shall apply as if the receptacle were being carried by road;</Addition> </Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“owner” in relation to a pressure system means the employer or self-employed person who owns the pressure system or, if he does not have a place of business in Northern Ireland, his agent in Northern Ireland or, if there is no such agent, the user;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“pipeline” means a pipe or system of pipes used for the conveyance of relevant fluid across the boundaries of premises, together with any apparatus for inducing or facilitating the flow of relevant fluid through, or through a part of, the pipe or system, and any valves, valve chambers, pumps, compressors and similar works which are annexed to, or incorporated in the course of, the pipe or system;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“pipework” means a pipe or system of pipes together with associated valves, pumps, compressors and other pressure containing components and includes a hose or bellows but does not include a pipeline or any protective devices;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text> <Addition ChangeId="key-E5-1790592089431" CommentaryRef="key-E5">“pressure receptacle” has the meaning  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="key-E5-1790592089431" CommentaryRef="key-E5"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E3-1790600511656" CommentaryRef="key-E3">assigned by regulation 2(3) of CDG 2010</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="key-E5-1790592089431" CommentaryRef="key-E5">, except that it includes any permanent fitting to a pressure receptacle, and regulation 2(1) shall apply as if the receptacle were being carried by road;</Addition> </Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“pressure system” means –</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha"><ListItem><Para><Text>a system comprising one or more pressure vessels of rigid construction, any associated pipework and protective devices;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>the pipework with its protective devices to which a  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E6-1790592279641" CommentaryRef="key-E6">pressure receptacle, an old pressure receptacle or transportable pressure equipment</Substitution>  is, or is intended to be, connected; or</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>a pipeline and its protective devices,</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList><Text>which contains or is liable to contain a relevant fluid, but does not include a  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E7-1790592380257" CommentaryRef="key-E7">pressure receptacle, an old pressure receptacle or transportable pressure equipment</Substitution>;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“protective devices” means devices designed to protect the pressure system against system failure and devices designed to give warning that system failure might occur, and include bursting discs;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“relevant fluid” means –</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha"><ListItem><Para><Text>steam;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>any fluid or mixture of fluids which is at a pressure greater than 0·5 bar above atmospheric pressure, and which fluid or mixture of fluids is –</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman"><ListItem><Para><Text>a gas, or</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem NumberOverride="ii"><Para><Text>a liquid which would have a vapour pressure greater than 0·5 bar above atmospheric pressure when in equilibrium with its vapour at either the actual temperature of the liquid or 17·5 degrees Celsius; or</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>a gas dissolved under pressure in a solvent contained in a porous substance at ambient temperature and which could be released from the solvent without the application of heat;</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“safe operating limits” means the operating limits (incorporating a suitable margin of safety) beyond which system failure is liable to occur;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“scheme of examination” means the written scheme referred to in regulation 8;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“system failure” means the unintentional release of stored energy (other than from a pressure relief system) from a pressure system;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“territorial sea” means the territorial sea of the United Kingdom adjacent to Northern Ireland and “within the territorial sea” includes on, over and under it;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E8"/>...</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text> <Substitution ChangeId="key-E9-1790592656108" except that it shall exclude a tank within the meaning of those Regulations;</Substitution> </Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“user” in relation to a pressure system, or a vessel to which </Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>a quarry within the meaning of  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E10-1790592895857" CommentaryRef="key-E10">regulation 3 of the Quarries Regulations (Northern UK_nisr_2006_204/2f7d131f0e.xml: <Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/204/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/204/regulation/2" id="regulation-2"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>2</Pnumber><P1para><Text>In these Regulations—</Text><UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition"><ListItem><Para><Text>“appoint” in relation to a person means appoint in writing with a written statement summarising his duties and authority;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“competent” in relation to a person means a person with sufficient training, experience, knowledge and other qualities to enable him properly to undertake the duties assigned to him;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“detonator” means an initiator for explosives that contains a charge of high explosive fired by means of a flame, spark, electric current or shock tube;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“excavation” means any place at the quarry where minerals are or have been extracted and includes the ground, faces or sides of the quarry and any other incline;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“exploder” means a device designed for firing detonators;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“explosive” means an explosive article or explosive substance;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“explosive article” means an article containing one or more explosive substances;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“explosive substance” means—</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha"><ListItem><Para><Text>a solid or liquid substance, or</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>a mixture of solid or liquid substances or both,</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList><Text>which is capable by chemical reaction in itself of producing gas at such a temperature and pressure and at such a speed as could cause damage to surroundings or which is designed to produce an effect by heat, light, sound, gas or smoke or a combination of these as a result of non-detonative self-sustaining exothermic chemical reactions;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“explosives” means explosive articles or explosive substances;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text> <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1721139856484" CommentaryRef="key-E">“explosives store” means a building, enclosed area or metal structure where explosives are stored under a licence granted or registration issued under the Manufacture and Storage of Explosives Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006;</Substitution> </Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“misfire” means an occurrence in relation to the firing of shots where—</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha"><ListItem><Para><Text>testing before firing reveals broken continuity which cannot be rectified; or</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>a shot or any part of a shot fails to explode when an attempt is made to fire it;</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“operator” in relation to a quarry means the person in overall control of the working of the quarry;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“quarry” has the meaning assigned to it by the Quarries Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“safety fuse” means a flexible cord that contains an internal burning medium by which fire is conveyed at a continuous and uniform rate for the purpose of firing plain detonators or black powder, without initiating burning in a similar fuse that may be in lateral contact;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“shot” means a single shot or a series of shots fired as part of one blast;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“shotfirer” means a person appointed pursuant to regulation 4(2)(a)(ii) to be responsible for shotfiring operations;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“shotfiring operations” include—</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha"><ListItem><Para><Text>checking to ensure that the blasting specification is still appropriate for the site conditions at the time the blasting is to take place;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>mixing explosives;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>priming a cartridge;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>charging and stemming a shothole;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>linking or connecting a round of shots;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>withdrawal and sheltering of persons;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>inspecting and testing a shotfiring circuit;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>firing a shot; and</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>checking for misfires;</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“trainee shotfirer” means a person appointed pursuant to regulation 4(2)(a)(ii) to undergo training in shotfiring operations under the close personal supervision of a shotfirer; and</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“vehicle” means any mechanically propelled vehicle (including mechanically propelled plant).</Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in <CitationSubRef id="cgateult5-00006" SectionRef="regulation-2" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/204/regulation/2">reg. 2</CitationSubRef> substituted (1.12.2006) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425" id="cgateult5-00007" Class="NorthernIrelandStatutoryRule" Year="2006" Number="425" Title="The Manufacture and Storage of Explosives Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006">The Manufacture and Storage of Explosives Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006 (S.R. 2006/425)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cgateult5-00007" id="cgateult5-00008" <Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26" id="regulation-26">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>26</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/1" id="regulation-26-1" RestrictStartDate="2007-08-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The operator shall ensure that a suitable and sufficient appraisal of all proposed or existing excavations or tips at the quarry is undertaken by a competent person in order to determine whether any such excavation or tip is a significant hazard.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/2" id="regulation-26-2" RestrictStartDate="2007-08-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The operator shall ensure that—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/2/a" id="regulation-26-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any significant findings made during an appraisal, any conclusions reached in accordance with paragraph (1) and the reasons for those conclusions are recorded by the competent person undertaking the appraisal;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/2/b" id="regulation-26-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the said competent person signs and dates any such record; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/2/c" id="regulation-26-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the record made in accordance with sub-paragraph (a) is made available to each employer of persons at work at the quarry and to all persons at work at the quarry.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3" id="regulation-26-3" RestrictStartDate="2007-08-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the conclusion reached by the competent person following an appraisal made pursuant to paragraph (1) is that the excavation or tip presents no significant hazard, the operator shall ensure that a competent person carries out further such appraisals—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/a" id="regulation-26-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at appropriate intervals;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/b" id="regulation-26-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>whenever there is any reason to suspect that there has been or will be a significant change to—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/b/i" id="regulation-26-3-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the matters to which the appraisal relates; or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/b/ii" id="regulation-26-3-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>any neighbouring land which may be affected by movement by or instability of the excavation or tip to which the appraisal relates; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/3/c" id="regulation-26-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>whenever there is any reason to doubt the validity of the conclusion of the current appraisal.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/205/regulation/26/4" id="regulation-26-4" RestrictStartDate="2008-08-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the conclusion reached by the competent person following an appraisal made pursuant to paragraph (1) is that the excavation or tip represents a significant hazard, the operator shall ensure that a geotechnical assessment is carried out in accordance with the requirements of regulation 27 as soon as is reasonably practicable.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>
