UK_nisr_2006_425/2f3d599565.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5" id="regulation-11-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Paragraph (4) shall not apply to an application for a licence—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/a" id="regulation-11-5-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to store no more than 2000 kilograms of explosives to which paragraph (a)(i) or (b) of the definition of “explosive” in regulation 2(1) applies;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/b" id="regulation-11-5-b"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/c" id="regulation-11-5-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>relating to the manufacture of explosives by means of on-site mixing;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/d" id="regulation-11-5-d"><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>relating to the manufacture of ammonium nitrate blasting intermediate; <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>...</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/e" id="regulation-11-5-e"><Pnumber>e</Pnumber><P3para><Text>relating to the manufacture or storage of explosives by a person who wishes to carry on such manufacture or storage within a part of a site where another person already holds a licence for the manufacture or storage of explosives, and either—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/e/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/e/i" id="regulation-11-5-e-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the application relates to manufacturing or storage activities which would be permitted at that part of the site under the existing licence; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/e/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/e/ii" id="regulation-11-5-e-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>in the opinion of the Secretary of State, no significant new health and safety issues are raised by the application.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/f" id="regulation-11-5-f"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1720105409332" CommentaryRef="key-E">f</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1720105409332" CommentaryRef="key-E">which is to follow, without a gap in time, a previous licence granted to follow, without a gap in time, a deemed licence for the purposes of regulation 26(3); or</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/g" id="regulation-11-5-g"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1720105409332" CommentaryRef="key-E">g</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1720105409332" CommentaryRef="key-E">relating to the manufacture of explosives by the Police Service of Northern Ireland for operational purposes or the training of its members in relation to those purposes.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text><CitationSubRef id="cftpivuq5-00016" SectionRef="regulation-11-5-f" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/f">Reg. 11(5)(f)</CitationSubRef><CitationSubRef id="cftpivuq5-00017" SectionRef="regulation-11-5-g" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/11/5/g">(g)</CitationSubRef> inserted (7.8.2009) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/248" id="cftpivuq5-00018" Class="NorthernIrelandStatutoryRule" Year="2009" Number="248" Title="The Manufacture and Storage of Explosives (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2009">The Manufacture and Storage of Explosives (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2009 (S.R. 2009/248)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cftpivuq5-00018" id="cftpivuq5-00019" SectionRef="regulation-1" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/248/regulation/1">reg. 1</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cftpivuq5-00018" id="cftpivuq5-00020" SectionRef="schedule-paragraph-5-b-iii" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/248/schedule/paragraph/5/b/iii" Operative="true">Sch. para. 5(b)(iii)</CitationSubRef></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_nisr_2006_425/a9ed4913ac.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2" id="regulation-10-2"><P2para><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d" id="regulation-10-2-d"><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the storage of no more than 100 kilograms of—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d/i" id="regulation-10-2-d-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>Hazard Type 3 explosives consisting of fireworks;</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d/ii" id="regulation-10-2-d-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>shooters' powder; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d/iii" id="regulation-10-2-d-iii"><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>a combination of shooters' powder and Hazard Type 3 and 4 explosives consisting of fireworks,</Text></P4para></P4><Text>provided that the explosives are stored for no longer than 3 <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1720102986868" CommentaryRef="key-E">consecutive</Addition>days     in their place of intended use;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/e" id="regulation-10-2-e"><P3para><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/e/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/e/i" id="regulation-10-2-e-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>no more than 250 kilograms of Hazard Type 4 explosives provided that the explosives are stored for no longer than 3 <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1720103018545" CommentaryRef="key-E">consecutive</Addition> days consecutive  in their place of intended use; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/e/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/e/ii" id="regulation-10-2-e-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>no more than 50 kilograms of Hazard Type 4 explosives consisting solely of fireworks, provided that the fireworks are stored for no longer than 21 <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1720103064444" CommentaryRef="key-E">consecutive</Addition> days and are not for sale or for use at work;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in <CitationSubRef id="cfto2uhx5-00009" SectionRef="regulation-10-2-d" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/d">reg. 10(2)(d)</CitationSubRef><CitationSubRef id="cfto2uhx5-00010" SectionRef="regulation-10-2-e" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/10/2/e">(e)</CitationSubRef> inserted (7.8.2009) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/248" id="cfto2uhx5-00011" Class="NorthernIrelandStatutoryRule" Year="2009" Number="248" Title="The Manufacture and Storage of Explosives (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2009">The Manufacture and Storage of Explosives (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2009 (S.R. 2009/248)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cfto2uhx5-00011" id="cfto2uhx5-00012" SectionRef="regulation-1" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/248/regulation/1">reg. 1</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cfto2uhx5-00011" id="cfto2uhx5-00013" SectionRef="schedule-paragraph-4-a-i" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/248/schedule/paragraph/4/a/i" Operative="true">Sch. para. 4(a)(i)</CitationSubRef></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15" id="regulation-15"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>15</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/1" id="regulation-15-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Secretary of State may vary a licence—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/1/a" id="regulation-15-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>where there is a change in circumstances such that the separation distances can no longer be maintained and a consequent reduction in the maximum quantity of explosives that may be stored is required;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/1/b" id="regulation-15-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>(in cases where the public hearing procedure was required pursuant to regulation 11(4) <Addition ChangeId="key-E3-1720103749018" CommentaryRef="key-E3">, or in cases where that procedure was not required by virtue of regulation 11(5)(e),</Addition>  before the grant of the licence) where there is a material change in circumstances so that a variation is necessary to ensure safety; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/1/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/1/c" id="regulation-15-1-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in relation to any of the matters to which it relates, by agreement with the licensee.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2" id="regulation-15-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Subject to regulation 17, a licence may be varied on the grounds referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or (b) without the agreement of the licensee.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2A" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2A" id="regulation-15-2A"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1720103711541" CommentaryRef="key-E4">2A</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1720103711541" CommentaryRef="key-E4">The Secretary of State may vary a registration—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2A/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2A/a" id="regulation-15-2A-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1720103711541" CommentaryRef="key-E4">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1720103711541" CommentaryRef="key-E4">where there has been a change of circumstances such that the separation distances can no longer be maintained and a consequent reduction in the quantity of explosives that may be stored is required so as to reduce that quantity to one specified by the Secretary of State which is below the maximum quantity referred to in regulation 13(1) for the kind of explosives concerned;</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2A/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2A/b" id="regulation-15-2A-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1720103711541" CommentaryRef="key-E4">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1720103711541" CommentaryRef="key-E4">so as to change the period for which the registration is in operation; and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2A/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/2A/c" id="regulation-15-2A-c"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1720103711541" CommentaryRef="key-E4">c</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1720103711541" CommentaryRef="key-E4">in relation to any of the matters to which it relates, by agreement with the registered person.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/3" id="regulation-15-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In cases where the public hearing procedure—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/3/a" id="regulation-15-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>was required under regulation 11(4) before the grant of the licence; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/3/b" id="regulation-15-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>would have been so required but for the operation of regulation 26(4) or (14),</Text></P3para></P3><Text>the provisions of regulation 12 shall apply in respect of a proposed variation referred to in paragraph (4).</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/4" id="regulation-15-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A proposed variation for the purpose of paragraph (3) is one which—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/4/a" id="regulation-15-4-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>relates to changes in the permitted quantities or types of explosive as a result of which the licensee could be required to maintain a separation distance greater than the separation distance required before the variation and, in the opinion of the Secretary of State, significant new health and safety issues are raised by that proposed variation; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/4/b" id="regulation-15-4-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>would remove the period of the licence so that it would be unlimited as to time,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>and the Secretary of State shall refuse to vary a licence unless the procedure referred to in regulation 11(4) has been applied.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15/5" id="regulation-15-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this regulation any reference to varying a licence includes varying its conditions.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in <CitationSubRef id="cftoikml5-00006" SectionRef="regulation-15" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/regulation/15">reg. 15</CitationSubRef> heading added (7.8.2009) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/248" Storage of Explosives (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2009 (S.R. 2009/248)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cftoikml5-00007" id="cftoikml5-00008" SectionRef="regulation-1" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2009/248/regulation/1">reg. 1</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cftoikml5-00007" id="cftoikml5-00009" SectionRef="schedule-paragraph-7-a" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/192/regulation/77A/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/192/regulation/77A/3" id="regulation-77A-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">In this Part—</Addition></Text><UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition"><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">“Access point” means a physical point, located inside or outside the building, accessible to undertakings providing or authorised to provide public communications networks, where connection to the high-speed-ready in-building physical infrastructure is made available;</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">“High-speed electronic communications network” means an electronic communication network which is capable of delivering broadband access services at speeds of at least 30 Mbps;</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">“High-speed-ready in-building physical infrastructure” means in-building physical infrastructure intended to host elements or enable delivery of high-speed electronic communications networks;</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">“In-building physical infrastructure” means physical infrastructure or installations at the end-user’s location, including elements under joint ownership, intended to host wired and/or wireless access networks, where such access networks are capable of delivering electronic communications services and connecting the building access point with the network termination point;</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">“Major renovation works” means works at the end-user’s location encompassing structural modifications of the entire in-building physical infrastructure or of a significant part of it;</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">“Network termination point” means the physical point at which a subscriber is provided with access to a public communications network; in the case of networks involving switching or routing, the network termination point is identified by means of a specific network address, which may be linked to a subscriber number or name;</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">“Protected building” has the meaning assigned to it by regulation 38 in Part F; and</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" CommentaryRef="key-E">“Public communications network” means an electronic communications network used wholly or mainly for the provision of electronic communications services available to the public which support the transfer of information between network termination points.</Addition></Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2016-11-28"><Title><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1550833874061" id="regulation-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2000/95/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2000/95/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In these Regulations–</Text></P2para></P2><UnorderedList Decoration="none"><ListItem><Para><Text>“the 1995 Act” means the Environment Act 1995 <CommentaryRef Ref="c16005581"/>;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“applicant” means a person who applies for registration under regulation 6;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“contaminated equipment” means any equipment (including any transformer, capacitor or receptacle containing residual stocks) which–</Text></Para><OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens"><ListItem NumberOverride="a"><Para><Text>contains PCBs; or</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem NumberOverride="b"><Para><Text>having contained PCBs, has not been decontaminated,</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList><Para><Text>other than one which contains a total volume of PCBs, not exceeding 5 dm3, and for the purposes of this definition–</Text></Para><OrderedList Type="roman" Decoration="parens"><ListItem NumberOverride="i"><Para><Text>the PCB volume of a power capacitor shall be measured by reference to all of the separate elements of a combined set; and</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem NumberOverride="ii"><Para><Text>any thing of a type which may contain PCBs shall be treated as containing PCBs unless it is reasonable to assume the contrary;</Text></Para></ListItem></OrderedList></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“decontamination” means all operations which enable equipment, objects, materials or fluids contaminated by PCBs to be reused, recycled or disposed of under safe conditions, and which may include replacement, meaning all operations in which PCBs are replaced by suitable fluids not containing PCBs;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>...</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“disposal” means any of the operations D8, D9, D10, D12 (only in safe, deep, underground storage in dry rock formations and only for equipment containing PCBs or used PCBs which cannot be decontaminated) and D15 provided for in   <Substitution ChangeId="key-E3-1777039684044" CommentaryRef="key-E3">Annex I of Directive 2008/98EC of the European Parliament and of the Council on waste</Substitution>    and set out in Schedule 1 to these Regulations;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“holder” means the person who is in possession of PCBs, including any used PCBs or of any equipment;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“PCBs” means any of the following substances:–</Text></Para><UnorderedList Decoration="none"><ListItem><Para><Text>polychlorinated biphenyls;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>polychlorinated terphenyls;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>monomethyl-dibromo-diphenyl methane;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>monomethyl-dichloro-diphenyl methane;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>monomethyl-tetrachlorodiphenyl methane,</Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>and, except in regulations  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E4-1649947689400" CommentaryRef="key-E4">4(3A), (3C) and (4), 5(3) </Substitution><Substitution ChangeId="key-E4-1649947689400" CommentaryRef="key-E4"><Addition ChangeId="key-E5-1749137032460" CommentaryRef="key-E5">and (4),</Addition></Substitution><Substitution ChangeId="key-E4-1649947689400" CommentaryRef="key-E4">  and 9(3)</Substitution>, includes any mixture containing any of those substances in a total of more than 0.005% by weight;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“registered holder” means a person registered with SEPA in accordance with regulation 6, and a registered holder is a registered holder in relation to particular equipment if a description of that equipment, including its location, has been furnished to SEPA;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“SEPA” means the Scottish Environment Protection Agency, established under section 20 of the 1995 Act;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“transformer” includes ancillary equipment, that is to say, equipment that is an integral part of the site of which the transformer is part, including radiators, bushings, through-wall bushings, and capacitors on air blast circuit breakers;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“used PCBs” mean any PCBs which are waste within the meaning of  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E" CommentaryRef="key-E">section 75(2)(a) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 as read with section 75A of that Act</Substitution>.</Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList><P2 Divorces”).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/2" Register Office an alphabetical index of the entries in the Register of Divorces (in this section referred to as “the index”).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/3" id="section-28A-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d30p1547">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d30p1547">The Register of Divorces shall be in such form as may be prescribed.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/4" id="section-28A-4"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef ChangeId="d30p1547">cause a search of the index to be made on behalf of any person or permit that person to search the index himself;</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/4/b" id="section-28A-4-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d30p1547">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d30p1547">issue to any person an extract of any entry in the Register of Divorces which that person may require.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/5" id="section-28A-5"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d30p1547">5</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d30p1547">An extract of an entry in the Register of Divorces shall be sufficient evidence of the decree of divorce or, as the case may be, of declarator of nullity of marriage to which it relates.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/6" id="section-28A-6"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d30p1547">6</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d30p1547">The Registrar General may delete or amend any entry in the Register of Divorces or substitute another for it.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/49/section/28A/7" ChangeId="d30p1547"><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1707732518071" CommentaryRef="key-E2">or the sheriff.</Addition></Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="S" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/2/b" id="section-11G-2-b"><Pnumber><Addition lawfully carry on, or but for the impairment would be able lawfully to carry on, in that part of the environment,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/2/c" id="section-11G-2-c"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1473528605122" CommentaryRef="key-E">c</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1473528605122" CommentaryRef="key-E">the person had started to carry on, and had not ceased to carry on, the activity in that part of the environment before the occurrence began to happen,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/2/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/2/d" id="section-11G-2-d"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1473528605122" CommentaryRef="key-E">d</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1473528605122" CommentaryRef="key-E">some or all of that part of the environment is significantly impaired as a result of the breach of duty, and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/2/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/2/e" id="section-11G-2-e"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1473528605122" CommentaryRef="key-E">e</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1473528605122" CommentaryRef="key-E">as a direct consequence of that significant impairment, the person is not able to carry on the activity in question in so much of that part of the environment as is significantly impaired or profits less from carrying on the activity there.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/3" employee.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1965/57/section/11G/4" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1968/73/section/70/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1968/73/section/70/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1979/5/section/20/3/b" id="section-20-3-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p2526" CommentaryRef="c11247551">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition applies).</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1979/5/section/20/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1979/5/section/20/4" RestrictStartDate="2014-07-14"><Title><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Enforcement of decisions of the Seabed Disputes Chamber</Addition></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A" id="section-8A"><Pnumber PuncAfter=""><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">8A</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/1" id="section-8A-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">A decision of the Seabed Disputes Chamber of the Tribunal in relation to a dispute of a type described in Article 187(c), (d) or (e) of the Convention may be registered in the High Court or the Court of Session (“the registering court”) in such manner as may be prescribed by rules of court.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/2" id="section-8A-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Where a decision is registered under this section, it is to be treated for the following purposes as if it had been originally given by the registering court and had (where relevant) been entered—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/2/a" id="section-8A-2-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">its force and effect for the purposes of enforcement;</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/2/b" id="section-8A-2-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">the powers of the registering court in relation to its enforcement;</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/2/c" id="section-8A-2-c"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">c</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">the taking of proceedings for or with respect to its enforcement.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/3" id="section-8A-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Where a decision registered under this section provides for payment of a sum of money, the debt resulting from the registration is to carry interest as if the decision were a judgment of the registering court and the debt had become due on the date of registration.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/4" id="section-8A-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Where a decision is registered under this section, the reasonable costs and expenses of and incidental to its registration are to be recoverable as if they were sums recoverable under the decision.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/5" id="section-8A-5"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">5</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Costs or expenses recoverable by virtue of subsection (4) are to carry interest as if they were the subject of an order for costs and expenses made by the registering court on the date of registration.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/6" id="section-8A-6"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">6</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Subsection (2) is subject to any provision made by rules of court as to the manner in which and conditions subject to which a decision registered under this section may be enforced.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8A/7" id="section-8A-7"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">7</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">In the application of this section in relation to Scotland references to costs are to be disregarded.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-07-14"><Title><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Proof and admissibility of decisions of the Seabed Disputes Chamber</Addition></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B" id="section-8B"><Pnumber PuncAfter=""><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">8B</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/1" id="section-8B-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">For the purposes of section 8A a document, duly authenticated, which purports to be a copy of a decision given by the Seabed Disputes Chamber of the Tribunal is without further proof to be taken to be a true copy, unless the contrary is shown</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/2" id="section-8B-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">A document purporting to be a copy of a decision given by the Seabed Disputes Chamber of the Tribunal is duly authenticated for the purposes of this section if it purports—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/2/a" id="section-8B-2-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">to bear the seal of the Tribunal, or</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/2/b" id="section-8B-2-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">to be certified by any person in the person's capacity as a judge of the Tribunal, the Registrar of the Tribunal or a member of the staff of the Registrar to be a true copy of a decision given by the Tribunal.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8B/3" id="section-8B-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Nothing in this section prejudices the admission in evidence of any document which is admissible apart from this section.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-07-14"><Title><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">Recognition and enforcement of arbitration awards</Addition></Title><P1 ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">8C</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">An award made in pursuance of Article 188(2)(a) of the Convention (disputes concerning interpretation or application of contracts)—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8C/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8C/a" id="section-8C-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">is to be treated for the purposes of Part 3 of the Arbitration Act 1996 (recognition and enforcement of certain foreign awards) as a New York Convention award, and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1981/53/section/8C/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1981/53/section/8C/b" id="section-8C-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">is to be treated for the purposes of sections 18 to 22 of the Arbitration (Scotland) Act 2010 (which make similar provision for Scotland) as a Convention award,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1442926992446" CommentaryRef="key-E">whether or <Legislation><Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48" NumberOfProvisions="252" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2026-06-29"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/body" NumberOfProvisions="93" RestrictStartDate="2026-06-29"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/part/II" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/part/II" NumberOfProvisions="7" id="part-II" RestrictStartDate="2021-06-29"><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/part/II/crossheading/bail" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/part/II/crossheading/bail" NumberOfProvisions="2" RestrictExtent="E+W" id="part-II-crossheading-bail" RestrictStartDate="2009-10-01"><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2009-10-01"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/section/29" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/section/29" id="section-29"><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/section/29/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/section/29/1" id="section-29-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In section 81 of the <CommentaryRef Ref="c19338241"/><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536783470167" CommentaryRef="key-E">Senior Courts Act 1981</Substitution> —</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/section/29/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/section/29/1/a" id="section-29-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in subsection (1) (which lists cases in which the Crown Court may grant bail) at the end of paragraph (e) there shall be added—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><Text>or
                        </Text><P3><Pnumber>f</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to whom the Crown Court has granted a certificate under section 1(2) or 11(1A) of the Criminal Appeal Act 1968 or under subsection (1B) below;</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/section/29/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/section/29/1/b" id="section-29-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the following subsections shall be inserted after that subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The power conferred by subsection (1)(f) does not extend to a case to which section 12 or 15 of the Criminal Appeal Act 1968 (appeal against verdict of not guilty by reason of insanity or against finding of disability) applies.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1B</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A certificate under this subsection is a certificate that a case is fit for appeal on a ground which involves a question of law alone.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1C</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The power conferred by subsection (1)(f) is to be exercised—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>where the appeal is under section 1 or 9 of the Criminal Appeal Act 1968, by the judge who tried the case; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>where it is under section 10 of that Act, by the judge who passed the sentence.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1D</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The power may only be exercised within twenty-eight days from the date of the conviction appealed against, or in the case of appeal against sentence, from the date on which sentence was passed or, in the case of an order made or treated as made on conviction, from the date of the making of the order.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1E</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The power may not be exercised if the appellant has made an application to the Court of Appeal for bail in respect of the offence or offences to which the appeal relates.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1F</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be a condition of bail granted in the exercise of the power that, unless a notice of appeal has previously been lodged in accordance with subsection (1) of section 18 of the Criminal Appeal Act 1968—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>such a notice shall be so lodged within the period specified in subsection (2) of that section; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>not later than 14 days from the end of that period, the appellant shall lodge with the Crown Court a certificate from the registrar of criminal appeals that a notice of appeal was given within that period.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1G</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If the Crown Court grants bail to a person in the exercise of the power, it may direct him to appear—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>if a notice of appeal is lodged within the period specified in section 18(2) of the Criminal Appeal Act 1968 at such time and place as the Court of Appeal may require; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>if no such notice is lodged within that period, at such time and place as the Crown Court may require.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Part><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/part/V" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/part/V" NumberOfProvisions="27" id="part-V" RestrictStartDate="2026-06-29"><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/part/V/crossheading/persons-remanded-in-custody" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/part/V/crossheading/persons-remanded-in-custody" NumberOfProvisions="2" id="part-V-crossheading-persons-remanded-in-custody" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2009-10-01"><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2009-10-01"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/section/60" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/section/60" id="section-60"><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/section/60/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/section/60/1" id="section-60-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In section 81 of the <CommentaryRef Ref="c19339191"/><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536783718489" CommentaryRef="key-E">Senior Courts Act 1981</Substitution> —</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/section/60/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/section/60/1/a" id="section-60-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in subsection (1) (which lists cases in which the Crown Court may grant bail) at the end of paragraph (f) there shall be added</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><Text>or
                        </Text><P3><Pnumber>g</Pnumber><P3para><Text>who has been remanded in custody by a magistrates’ court on adjourning a case under—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>section 5 (adjournment of inquiry into offence);</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>section 10 (adjournment of trial);</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>section 18 (initial procedure on information agaist adult for offence triable either way); or</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iv</Pnumber><P4para><Text>section 30 (remand for medical examination),</Text></P4para></P4><Text>of the Magistrates’Courts Act 1980;</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1982/48/section/60/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1982/48/section/60/1/b" id="section-60-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the following subsections shall be inserted after that subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1H</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where the Crown Court grants a person bail under subsection (1)(g) it may direct him to appear at time and place which the magistrates’ court could have directed and the recognizance of any surety shall be conditioned accordingly.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1J</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Crown Court may only grant bail to a person under subsection (1)(g) if the magistrates’ court which remanded him in custody has certified under section 5(6A) of the Bail Act 1976 that it heard full argument on his application for bail before it refused the application.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation><Commentaries><Commentary IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62" id="section-62"><Pnumber>62</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/1" id="section-62-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text> <Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1527615277007" CommentaryRef="key-E2">Part 10 of Schedule 3A of the Communications Act 2003 (the electronic communications code)</Substitution>   (undertakers’ works) shall apply for the purposes—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/1/a" id="section-62-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>of any work in pursuance of an order or direction under section 44 or 46 of the 1982 Act, as applied by section 59 above, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/1/b" id="section-62-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>of anything done with respect to a highway in pursuance of an order under section 48 of the 1982 Act (as so applied) to which subsection (2) below applies.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para><P2para><Text>to the person doing that work or, as the case may be, the highway authority; and, in the case of any such order as is mentioned in paragraph (b), any person entitled to land over which the highway passes shall be entitled to require the alteration of the  <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1525942427194" CommentaryRef="key-E">electronic communications apparatus</Addition>  in question.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/2" id="section-62-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>This subsection applies to an order under section 48 of the 1982 Act where the order provides—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/2/a" id="section-62-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the stopping up or diversion of the highway, or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/2/b" id="section-62-2-b"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="c9343781"/><Addition ChangeId="d29p5140">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5140">for the improvement of the highway where the Secretary of State is not the highway authority,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><Text>and immediately before the order comes into operation any <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1525942370735" CommentaryRef="key-E">electronic communications apparatus</Addition>  is kept installed for the purposes of <Addition ChangeId="key-E3-1525942458475" CommentaryRef="key-E3">an electronic communications code network</Addition>  under, in, on, over, along or across the highway.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/3" id="section-62-3" RestrictStartDate="2003-12-29"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Subject to the preceding provisions of this section, the operator of <Addition ChangeId="key-E3-1525942471387" CommentaryRef="key-E3">an electronic communications code network</Addition>  shall, in a case falling within subsection (2)(a), have the same rights in respect of any apparatus kept installed for the purposes of <Addition ChangeId="key-E4-1525942506405" CommentaryRef="key-E4">that network</Addition>  as if the order had not come into operation.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/4" id="section-62-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text> <Substitution ChangeId="key-E5-1527615302549" CommentaryRef="key-E5">Part 10</Substitution>  of <Addition ChangeId="key-E6-1525942271708" CommentaryRef="key-E6">the electronic communications code</Addition>  shall not apply by virtue of subsection (2)(b) in relation to the alteration of any <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1525942382840" CommentaryRef="key-E">electronic communications apparatus</Addition>  where the alteration is for the purpose of <Addition ChangeId="d29p5163" CommentaryRef="c9343791">major highway works, major bridge works or major transport works within the meaning of Part III of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 or, in Scotland, major works for roads purposes, major bridge works or major transport works within the meaning of Part IV of that Act</Addition>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/5" id="section-62-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text> <Substitution ChangeId="key-E7-1527615342008" CommentaryRef="key-E7">Paragraph 68</Substitution>  (offence) shall be deemed to be omitted for the purposes of the application by this section of  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E8-1527615374931" CommentaryRef="key-E8">Part 10 of the code</Substitution>  to the Secretary of State.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/6" id="section-62-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Paragraph   <Substitution ChangeId="key-E9-1527615448442" CommentaryRef="key-E9">108(2)</Substitution>   of <Addition ChangeId="key-E6-1525942284172" CommentaryRef="key-E6">the electronic communications code</Addition>  (alteration of apparatus to include moving, removal or replacement of apparatus) shall apply for the purposes of the preceding provisions of this section as it applies for the purposes of the code.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/7" id="section-62-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text> <Substitution ChangeId="key-E10-1527615511174" CommentaryRef="key-E10">Part 6 of the electronic communications code (rights to require removal of apparatus)</Substitution>  shall apply in relation to any entitlement conferred by this section to require the alteration, moving or replacement of any <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1525942394392" CommentaryRef="key-E">electronic communications apparatus</Addition>  as it applies in relation to an entitlement to require the removal of any such apparatus.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/31/section/62/8" id="section-62-8" <P1para>
<Text>An investment company with variable capital is an authorised person as respects—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/60/section/24A/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/60/section/24A/a" id="section-24A-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>investment business which consists in operating the collective investment scheme constituted by the company; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1986/60/section/24A/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1986/60/section/24A/b" id="section-24A-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any investment business which is carried on by the company in connection with or for the purposes of operating that scheme.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Pblock><Commentaries/></Legislation>

			“Greater London: conformity with spatial development strategy.</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A" id="section-21A"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225"><CommentaryRef Ref="c14017241"/>21A</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/1" id="section-21A-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">Where—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/1/a" id="section-21A-1-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">a local planning authority in Greater London propose to make, alter or replace a unitary development plan;</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/1/b" id="section-21A-1-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">copies of proposed alterations of, or of a proposed new spatial development strategy to replace, the spatial development strategy have been made available for inspection under section 335(2) of the Greater London Authority Act 1999; and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/1/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/1/c" id="section-21A-1-c"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">c</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">the local planning authority include in any relevant copy of the plan or proposals a statement that they are making the permitted assumption,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">the permitted assumption shall, subject to subsection (4), be made for all purposes (including in particular any question as to conformity between the plan and the spatial development strategy).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/2" id="section-21A-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">In this section “</Addition><Term id="term-the-permitted-assumption"><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">the permitted assumption</Addition></Term><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">” means the assumption that—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/2/a" id="section-21A-2-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">the proposed alterations or new spatial development strategy mentioned in subsection (1)(b); or</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/2/b" id="section-21A-2-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">if any proposed modifications to those proposed alterations or that new spatial development strategy have been published in accordance with regulations made under section 343 of the Greater London Authority Act 1999, the proposed alterations or spatial development strategy as so modified,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">have become operative under section 337(9) of that Act.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/3" id="section-21A-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">For the purposes of subsection (1)(c) a copy is a relevant copy of a plan or proposals if it is served on the Greater London Authority.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1990/8/section/21A/4" id="section-21A-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p137225">The permitted assumption shall not be made at any time after the local planning authority know that the proposed alterations or new spatial development strategy mentioned in subsection (1)(b) have been withdrawn. ”</Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock><Commentaries/></Legislation>

DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/1" id="section-35E-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">The purpose of this section is that members of amount and essential characteristics of the share capital and debt used to fund the operations of the undertaker.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/3" id="section-35E-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">The overview should include significant changes that—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/3/a" id="section-35E-3-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">took IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/3/b" id="section-35E-3-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">are expected to take place in the period of 12 months following that publication,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">provided that the changes have been publicly announced.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/4" id="section-35E-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">The IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/4/a" id="section-35E-4-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">what information should be included in the overview, and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/4/b" id="section-35E-4-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">in what format it should be published,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">in order to fulfil the purpose set out in subsection (1) (as read with subsection (3)).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/5" has decided under subsection (4).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/6" CommentaryRef="key-E">6</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">It must do so by—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/6/a" id="section-35E-6-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">exercising its appointment powers, or</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/6/b" id="section-35E-6-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">issuing rules under this section.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/7" id="section-35E-7"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">7</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" CommentaryRef="key-E">The Authority’s “appointment powers” are—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/7/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/7/a" id="section-35E-7-a"><Pnumber><Addition IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/35E/7/b" id="section-35E-7-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1741184868894" UK_ukpga_1991_56/7e2e28400e.xml: <Legislation><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2013-04-01"><Title> Reference to <Addition ChangeId="d29p25817" CommentaryRef="c13219891">the  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25817" CommentaryRef="c13219891"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1599856787674" CommentaryRef="key-E">appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition>  of agreements relating to special category effluent.</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130" id="section-130"><Pnumber>130</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/1" id="section-130-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where a sewerage undertaker and the owner or occupier of any trade premises are proposing to enter into an agreement under section 129 above with respect to, or to any matter connected with, the reception or disposal of any special category effluent, it shall be the duty of the undertaker to refer to <Addition ChangeId="d29p25831" CommentaryRef="c13219891">the   </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25831" CommentaryRef="c13219891"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1599856851391" CommentaryRef="key-E">appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition>  the questions—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/1/a" id="section-130-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>whether the operations which would, for the purposes of or in connection with the reception or disposal of that effluent, be carried out in pursuance of the proposed agreement should be prohibited; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/1/b" id="section-130-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>whether, if they are not prohibited, any requirements should be imposed as to the conditions on which they are carried out.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/2" id="section-130-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of a sewerage undertaker where it has made a reference under this section not to give any consent or enter into any agreement with respect to any such operations as are mentioned in subsection (1)(a) above at any time before <Addition ChangeId="d29p25853" CommentaryRef="c13219891">the   </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25853" CommentaryRef="c13219891"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1599856896035" CommentaryRef="key-E">appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition>  serves notice on the undertaker of his determination on the reference.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/3" id="section-130-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Every reference under this section shall be made in writing and shall be accompanied by a copy of the proposed agreement.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/4" id="section-130-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of a sewerage undertaker, on making a reference under this section, to serve a copy of the reference on the owner or the occupier of the trade premises in question, according to whether it is the owner or occupier who is proposing to be a party to the agreement.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/7" id="section-130-7"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="c13219921"/><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">7</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">If a sewerage undertaker fails, before giving any consent or entering into any agreement with respect to any such operations as are mentioned in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) above, to refer to the  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1599856955678" CommentaryRef="key-E">appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">  any question which he is required by that subsection to refer to  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1599857175649" CommentaryRef="key-E2">the appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">, the undertaker shall be guilty of an offence and liable—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/7/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/7/a" id="section-130-7-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">on summary conviction, to a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum;</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/7/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/7/b" id="section-130-7-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">on conviction on indictment, to a fine.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/8" id="section-130-8"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">8</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">If the  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1599856998405" CommentaryRef="key-E">appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">  becomes aware—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/8/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/8/a" id="section-130-8-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">that a sewerage undertaker and the owner or occupier of any trade premises are proposing to enter into any such agreement as is mentioned in subsection (1) above, and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/8/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/8/b" id="section-130-8-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">that the sewerage undertaker has not referred to </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1599857276335" CommentaryRef="key-E2">the appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869"> any question which it is required to refer to  </Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1603407071172" CommentaryRef="key-E2">the appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">  by that subsection,</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><Text> <Addition ChangeId="d29p25869"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E2-1599857310608" CommentaryRef="key-E2">the appropriate agency</Substitution></Addition><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">  may proceed as if the reference required by that subsection had been made.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/130/9" id="section-130-9"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">9</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p25869">If UK_ukpga_1991_56/87ec7189fd.xml: <Legislation><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/part/III/chapter/II/crossheading/use-of-limiting-devices" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/part/III/chapter/II/crossheading/use-of-limiting-devices" NumberOfProvisions="1" id="part-III-chapter-II-crossheading-use-of-limiting-devices" RestrictStartDate="1999-06-30"><Title><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344"> Use of limiting devices</Addition></Title><P1group RestrictStartDate="1999-06-30"><Title><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344"> Prohibition of use of limiting devices.</Addition></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A" id="section-63A"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="c13218341"/><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">63A</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/1" id="section-63A-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">A water undertaker shall be guilty of an offence under this section if it uses a limiting device in relation to any premises specified in Schedule 4A to this Act, with the intention of enforcing payment of charges which are or may become due to the undertaker in respect of the supply of water to the premises.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/2" id="section-63A-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">For the purposes of this section “</Addition><Term id="term-a-limiting-device"><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">a limiting device</Addition></Term><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">”, in relation to any premises, means any device or apparatus which—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/2/a" id="section-63A-2-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">is fitted to any pipe by which water is supplied to the premises or a part of the premises, whether that pipe belongs to the undertaker or to any other person, and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/2/b" id="section-63A-2-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">is designed to restrict the use which may be made of water supplied to the premises by the undertaker.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/3" id="section-63A-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">An undertaker does not commit an offence under this section by disconnecting a service pipe to any premises or otherwise cutting off a supply of water to the premises.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/63A/4" id="section-63A-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p14344">An undertaker guilty of an offence under this section shall be liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock><Commentaries/></Legislation>
