or</Addition></Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/18/4/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/18/4/iv" id="section-18-4-iv"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="d29p5680" CommentaryRef="c19760851">iv</Addition></Pnumber><P4para><Text><Addition ChangeId="d29p5680" CommentaryRef="c19760851">is likely to cause or contribute to any such contravention;</Addition></Text></P4para></P4><Text>and</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1991/56/section/18/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1991/56/section/18/4/b" id="section-18-4-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the provision made by the order (with any modifications) is requisite for the purpose of securing compliance with that condition or requirement.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="c19760851" Type="F"><Para><Text>S. 18(4)(iii)(iv) and preceding word inserted (1.12.2005) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2003/37" id="c00562" Year="2003" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Number="37" Title="Water Act 2003">Water Act 2003 (c. 37)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c00562" id="c00563" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2003/37/section/101/1" SectionRef="section-101-1">ss. 101(1)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c00562" id="c00564" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2003/37/section/105/3" SectionRef="section-105-3">105(3)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="c00562" id="c00565" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2003/37/schedule/8/paragraph/4/5" SectionRef="schedule-8-paragraph-4-5" Operative="true">Sch. 8 para. 4(5)</CitationSubRef>; UK_ukpga_1996_52/e8bd998ca2.xml: <Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/86" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/86" id="section-86"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="c13151211"/>86</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1" id="section-82-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Part II of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1987 (appointment of managers by the court) is amended as follows for the purpose of transferring to a leasehold valuation tribunal the jurisdiction of the court under that Part.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n1" id="section-82-1n1"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In the following contexts for “the court”, in the first (or only) place where it occurs, substitute “a leasehold valuation tribunal”: section 21(1), section 22(2)(b), section 22(3), section 23(1), section 24(1), (2), (9) and (10); and in every other context in those sections, except section 21(6), for “the court” substitute “the tribunal”. </Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n2" id="section-82-1n2"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In section 21(6) (exclusion of application under inherent jurisdiction of court) for “any jurisdiction existing apart from this Act” substitute “any jurisdiction”.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n3" id="section-82-1n3"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n4" id="section-82-1n4"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/82/1n5" id="section-82-1n5"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In section 52 of the <CommentaryRef Ref="M_M_02ce3d06-3c83-4b2d-f64c-6368ffa98432"/>Landlord and Tenant Act 1987 (jurisdiction of county courts), in subsection (2)(a) for “Parts I to IV” substitute “Parts I, III and IV”.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_ukpga_1996_52/f24c23ebe7.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12" id="section-12" RestrictStartDate="2010-04-01"><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/1" id="section-12-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The charge taking effect by virtue of  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1495618613114" CommentaryRef="key-E">                      section 11B
                    </Substitution>  (charge for repayment of discount) has priority immediately after any legal charge securing an amount—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/1/a" id="section-12-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>left outstanding by the purchaser, or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/1/b" id="section-12-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>advanced to him by an approved lending institution for the purpose of enabling him to acquire the interest disposed of on the first disposal,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>subject to the following provisions.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/2" id="section-12-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>An advance which is made for a purpose other than that mentioned in subsection (1)(b) and which is secured by a legal charge having priority to the charge taking effect by virtue of  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1495618634083" CommentaryRef="key-E">                      section 11B
                    </Substitution> , and any further advance which is so secured, shall rank in priority to that charge if, and only if, the registered social landlord by notice served on the institution concerned gives consent.</Text></P2para><P2para><Text>The landlord shall give consent if the purpose of the advance or further advance is an approved purpose.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/3" id="section-12-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The registered social landlord may at any time by notice served on an approved lending institution postpone the charge taking effect by virtue of  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1495618654194" CommentaryRef="key-E">                      section 11B
                    </Substitution>  to an advance or further advance which—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/3/a" id="section-12-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>is made to the purchaser by that institution, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/3/b" id="section-12-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>is secured by a legal charge not having priority to that charge;</Text></P3para></P3><Text>and the landlord shall serve such a notice if the purpose of the advance or further advance is an approved purpose.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/4" id="section-12-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The covenant required by  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1495618671167" CommentaryRef="key-E">                      section 11B
                    </Substitution>  does not, by virtue of its binding successors in title of the purchaser, bind a person exercising rights under a charge having priority over the charge taking effect by virtue of that section, or a person deriving title under him.</Text></P2para><P2para><Text>A provision of the conveyance, grant or assignment, or of a collateral agreement, is void in so far as it purports to authorise a forfeiture, or to impose a penalty or disability, in the event of any such person failing to comply with that covenant.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/6" id="section-12-6"><P2para><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/6/b" id="section-12-6-b"><P3para><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/6/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1996/52/section/12/6/b/i" id="section-12-6-b-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>so much as is still outstanding of any advance or further advance which ranks in priority to the charge taking effect by virtue of  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1495618695194" CommentaryRef="key-E">                      section 11B
                    </Substitution> ,</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in s. 12 substituted (18.1.2005) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2004/34" id="ckp3vgdy2-00007" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="2004" Number="34" Title="Housing Act 2004">Housing Act 2004 (c. 34)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ckp3vgdy2-00008" CitationRef="ckp3vgdy2-00007" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2004/34/section/199/2" SectionRef="section-199-2" Operative="true">ss. 199(2)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef id="ckp3vgdy2-00009" CitationRef="ckp3vgdy2-00007" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2004/34/section/270/3/a" SectionRef="section-270-3-a">270(3)(a)</CitationSubRef> (with <CitationSubRef id="ckp3vgdy2-00010" CitationRef="ckp3vgdy2-00007" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2004/34/section/199/3" SectionRef="section-199-3">s. 199(3)</CitationSubRef>)</Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_ukpga_1998_46/f4daddc6a8.xml: PART 2A<Addition ChangeId="key-E-1475681800292" CommentaryRef="key-E">Permanence of the Scottish Parliament and Scottish Government</Addition><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1475681800292" CommentaryRef="key-E">Permanence of the Scottish Parliament and Scottish Government</Addition>63A1The Scottish Parliament and the Scottish Government are a permanent part of the United Kingdom's constitutional arrangements.2The purpose of this section is, with due regard to the other provisions of this Act, to signify the commitment of the Parliament and Government of the United Kingdom to the Scottish Parliament and the Scottish Government.3In view of that commitment it is declared that the Scottish Parliament and the Scottish Government are not to be abolished except on the basis of a decision of the people of Scotland voting in a referendum.Pt. 2A inserted (23.3.2016) by Scotland Act 2016 (c. 11), ss. 1, 72(1)(a)

RestrictStartDate="2014-07-17"><Title><Emphasis><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">Gifts </Addition><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">... relief</Addition></Emphasis></Title><P1group RestrictStartDate="2012-07-17"><Title><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">Tax treatment of gifts qualifying for gift aid relief</Addition></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D" id="section-661D"><Pnumber PuncAfter=""><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">661D</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/1" id="section-661D-1"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">1</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">This section applies if a gift is made to a registered club by an individual and the gift is a qualifying donation for the purposes of Chapter 2 of Part 8 of ITA 2007 (gift aid).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/2" id="section-661D-2"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">2</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">The club is treated as receiving, under deduction of income tax at the basic rate for the tax year in which the gift is made, a gift of an amount equal to the grossed up amount of the gift.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/3" id="section-661D-3"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">3</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">The income tax treated as deducted is treated as income tax paid by the club.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/4" id="section-661D-4"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">4</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">The grossed up amount of the gift is treated as an amount in respect of which the club is chargeable to corporation tax, under the charge to corporation tax on income.</Addition></Text></P2para><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">But this is subject to section 664 (exemption for interest and gift aid income).</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2010/4/section/661D/5" id="section-661D-5"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">5</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1486681978968" CommentaryRef="key-E2">References in this section to the grossed up amount of the gift are to the amount of the gift grossed up by reference to the basic rate for the tax year in which the gift is made.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-07-17"><Title><Addition ChangeId="key-E3-1502867934349" CommentaryRef="key-E3">Tax treatment of gifts of money from companies</Addition></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/4/section/661E" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2010/4/section/661E" id="section-661E"><Pnumber PuncAfter=""><Addition ChangeId="key-E3-1502867934349" CommentaryRef="key-E3">661E</Addition></Pnumber><P1para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E3-1502867934349" CommentaryRef="key-E3">If a registered club receives a gift of a sum of money from a company which is not a charity, the gift is treated as an amount in respect of which the registered club is chargeable to corporation tax, under the charge to corporation tax on income.</Addition></Text></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock><Commentaries/></Legislation>

statutory instrument modify the Investigatory Powers Act 2016 so as to alter, for the purposes of any of the specified provisions of that Act (see subsection (3)), the length of a period referred to in that Act as  “the relevant period”.</Repeal></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/3" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/3/a" id="section-23-3-a"><Pnumber><Repeal 							(period within which Judicial Commissioner must decide whether to approve decision to issue urgent warrant);</Repeal></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/3/b" id="section-23-3-b"><Pnumber><Repeal ChangeId="key-E-1639834186298" CommentaryRef="key-E" RetainText="true" Extent="E+N.I.">b</Repeal></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Repeal ChangeId="key-E-1639834186298" CommentaryRef="key-E" RetainText="true" Extent="E+N.I.">sections 32(2)(a), 116(2)(a), 184(2)(a) and 213(2)(a)
							(period at end of which urgent warrant ceases to have effect);</Repeal></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/3/c" id="section-23-3-c"><Pnumber><Repeal ChangeId="key-E-1639834186298" CommentaryRef="key-E" RetainText="true" Extent="E+N.I.">c</Repeal></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Repeal ChangeId="key-E-1639834186298" CommentaryRef="key-E" RetainText="true" Extent="E+N.I.">sections 33(5)(a), 117(5)(a), 185(3)(a) and 214(3)(a)

							(period within which Judicial Commissioner or other appropriate person must decide whether to approve decision to make urgent modification of warrant).</Repeal></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2020/7/section/23/4" 531Every consignee must make a return, in these Regulations referred to as a consignee quarterly return, to the NRBW of information relating to all consignments of hazardous waste received by him or her in any quarter in accordance with paragraph (4).2The return must include—arejected consignments;bhazardous waste delivered by pipeline where regulation 41 applies; andcin the case of multiple collections, each individual consignment collected.3Where in any quarter hazardous waste is disposed of by depositing it within the curtilage of the premises at which it is produced, the producer must make a return in respect of that quarter of information relating to the deposit to the NRBW, in accordance with paragraph (4).4A return to be made pursuant to this regulation in respect of a quarter must be made no later than the time specified in the right hand column of the table below in relation to the quarter specified in the left hand column:
Quarter in which the hazardous waste was received, or deposited, as the case may beReturn to be received by the NRBW not later than
Ending on 31 March30 April in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 30 June31 July in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 30 September31 October in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 31 December31 January in the year next following the year in which quarter falls
5The NRBW may prescribe a format for returns to be made under this regulation and, where for the time being a format is prescribed pursuant to this paragraph—athe NRBW must publish the format on its website and in such other manner as it may consider appropriate for informing persons required to submit such returns of its content; andbthe NRBW is not obliged to consider a return as properly made for the purposes of these Regulations unless it is made in that format, or in a format substantially to like effect.6If the NRBW prescribes a fee payable by a consignee by charging scheme made under section 41 of the Environment Act 1995 as a means of recovering its costs incurred in performing functions in relation to the consignments included on the consignee quarterly returns, a consignee may recover from a consignor any fees paid under these Regulations in relation to consignments sent by that consignor.Words in reg. 53 substituted (1.4.2013) by The Natural Resources Body for Wales (Functions) Order 2013 (S.I. 2013/755), art. 1(2), Sch. 5 para. 30(h) (with Sch. 7)

UK_uksi_2006_3336/57889ce49d.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6" id="article-161-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Without limiting the terms which may be included in an agreement under this Article—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/a" id="article-161-6-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>such terms may include terms as to the provision of such security as the undertaker may reasonably require for the discharge of any obligations imposed on the other party to the agreement; <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>...</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b" id="article-161-6-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>such terms relating to a drain may include in particular —</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/i" id="article-161-6-b-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>identification of that part of the drain which constitutes the lateral drain for the purposes of the agreement and, in particular, the point or points of connection between that part and the remainder of the drain;</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/ii" id="article-161-6-b-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>a requirement for the installation of an inspection chamber, at the expense of the person with whom the sewerage undertaker is to make the agreement, at a place specified in the agreement;</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/iii" id="article-161-6-b-iii"><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>provision, if the inspection chamber is constructed in accordance with the terms of the agreement, for the undertaker to declare that the inspection chamber be vested in the undertaker at the same time as the lateral drain; and</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/b/iv" id="article-161-6-b-iv"><Pnumber>iv</Pnumber><P4para><Text>provision for the lateral drain, once vested in the undertaker, to communicate with a public sewer at the place or places specified in the agreement<Addition ChangeId="key-E-1515426795543" CommentaryRef="key-E">; and</Addition></Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/3336/article/161/6/c" id="article-161-6-c"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1515426795543" CommentaryRef="key-E">c</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-E-1515426795543" CommentaryRef="key-E">an agreement relating to a sewer or drain may include terms requiring the other party to construct one or more sustainable drainage systems designed to receive surface water from any premises served by that sewer or drain.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Art. 161(6)(c) inserted and preceding word inserted (24.5.2016 with application as mentioned in s. 8(1) of the amending Act) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7" id="ctsmjfo02-00072" Class="NorthernIrelandAct" Year="2016" Number="7" Title="Water and Sewerage Services Act (Northern Ireland) 2016">Water and Sewerage Services Act (Northern Ireland) 2016 (c. 7)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="ctsmjfo02-00073" CitationRef="ctsmjfo02-00072" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7/section/4/5" SectionRef="section-4-5" Operative="true">ss. 4(5)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef id="ctsmjfo02-00074" CitationRef="ctsmjfo02-00072" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7/section/8" SectionRef="section-8">8</CitationSubRef></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2008_1597/5df7785213.xml: Non-compliance with <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1650459142758" CommentaryRef="key-E">UK</Substitution> marking requirements211For the purposes of this regulation, a product is deficient as regards UK marking—aif it is not subject to these Regulations, but the UK marking is affixed to it (or, where regulation 7(2A) applies, to a label affixed to it or a document accompanying it) pursuant to these Regulations; orbif it is machinery and—ithe UK marking is not affixed to it (or, where regulation 7(2A) applies, to a label affixed to it or a document accompanying it);iiit is not accompanied by a copy of the ... declaration of conformity; oriiithe UK marking is affixed to it (or, where regulation 7(2A) applies, to a label affixed to it or a document accompanying it) but it does not conform to the relevant provisions of these Regulations; oriva marking other than the UK marking, which is prohibited by regulation 15(2) or (3), is affixed to it (or, where regulation 7(2A) applies, to a label affixed to it or a document accompanying it).2Where an enforcement authority has reasonable grounds for suspecting that a product is deficient as regards UK marking, but does not have reasonable grounds for suspecting that it is not safe, the enforcement authority may take action under the following provisions as they are applied by Schedule 5—ain the case of the Health and Safety Executive, the Office for Nuclear Regulation or the Office of Rail and Road, section 20 of the 1974 Act;bin the case of the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland, Article 22 of the 1978 Order; andcin the case of any other enforcement authority, section 29 of the 1987 Act,but no other action may be taken pursuant to Schedule 5 and no proceedings may be brought pursuant to regulation 22 in respect of that product until the enforcement authority has served on the responsible person a notice in writing in accordance with paragraph (3) and the responsible person has failed to comply with its requirements.3Where an enforcement authority has reasonable grounds for considering that a product is deficient as regards UK marking, it may serve a notice on the responsible person which—aidentifies the product concerned;bstates that the enforcement authority considers that it is deficient as regards UK marking and the reasons why the authority considers that this is the case;crequires the responsible person to take (or refrain from taking) specified action within a specified period to bring the deficiency to an end; anddwarns the responsible person that if the deficiency continues beyond the period specified in the notice, further action may be taken under these Regulations.4In any proceedings under regulation 22 in respect of a person's alleged failure to comply with a notice under paragraph (3), an enforcement authority must show that the product concerned was deficient as regards UK marking at the time when the notice was served.Word in reg. 21 heading substituted (E.W.S.) (31.12.2020) by The Product Safety and Metrology etc. (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/696), reg. 1, Sch. 12 para. 21(a) (with Sch. 12 para. 22) (as amended by S.I. 2020/676, regs. 1(1), 2); 2020 c. 1, Sch. 5 para. 1(1)

UK_uksi_2010_231/514b474895.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/1" id="article-4-1" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>There is to be a body corporate known as the General Pharmaceutical Council (“the Council”).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/2" id="article-4-2" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Council is to be constituted as provided for by an order of the Privy Council made under this article subject to the provisions of Schedule 1 to this Order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3" id="article-4-3" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The principal functions of the Council are—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/a" id="article-4-3-a" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to establish and maintain a register of pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and premises at which a retail pharmacy business is, or is to be, carried on;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/b" id="article-4-3-b" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to set and promote standards for the safe and effective practice of pharmacy at registered pharmacies;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/c" id="article-4-3-c" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to set requirements by reference to which registrants must demonstrate that their fitness to practise is not impaired;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/d" id="article-4-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to promote the safe and effective practice of pharmacy by registrants (including, for example, by reference to any code of conduct for, and ethics relating to, pharmacy);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/e" id="article-4-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to set standards and requirements in respect of the education, training, acquisition of experience and continuing professional development that it is necessary for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians to achieve in order to be entered in the Register or to receive an annotation in the Register and to maintain competence; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/f" id="article-4-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to ensure the continued fitness to practise of registrants.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/4" id="article-4-4" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Council has the functions conferred on it by this Order and such other functions as may be conferred on it by the Privy Council by order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/5" id="article-4-5" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before making an order under paragraph (4), the Privy Council must consult the Council.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6" id="article-4-6" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Council must have the following committees—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/a" id="article-4-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Investigating Committee;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/b" id="article-4-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Fitness to Practise Committee; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/c" id="article-4-6-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Appeals Committee,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>and each of those committees has the functions assigned to it by or under this Order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/7" id="article-4-7" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Council may establish such other committees as it considers appropriate in connection with the discharge of its functions and may delegate any of its functions to them, except any power to make rules.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/8" id="article-4-8" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Schedule 1 makes further provision about the Council, its committees, its staff, its publications and its accounts.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69" id="article-69">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>69</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/1" id="article-69-1" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The transitional provisions contained in Schedule 5 have effect.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/2" id="article-69-2" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The savings contained in Schedule 6 have effect.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/3" id="article-69-3" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In connection with the commencement of any provision of this Order, the Privy Council may by order make such transitional, transitory or saving provisions as it considers appropriate.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4" id="article-69-4" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The power to make an order under paragraph (3) may be exercised—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/a" id="article-69-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>so as to make different provision—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/a/i" id="article-69-4-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>with respect to different cases or different classes of cases, or</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/a/ii" id="article-69-4-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in respect of the same case or class of case for different purposes;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/b" id="article-69-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to all cases to which the power extends or in relation to all those cases subject to specified exceptions; or</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/69/4/c" id="article-69-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>so as to make any supplementary, incidental or consequential provisions which the Privy Council considers necessary or expedient.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2010_231/92b299bed8.xml:
<Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E3"/>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/1" id="article-4-1" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>There is to be a body corporate known as the General Pharmaceutical Council (“the Council”).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/2" id="article-4-2" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Council is to be constituted as provided for by an order of the Privy Council made under this article subject to the provisions of Schedule 1 to this Order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3" id="article-4-3" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The principal functions of the Council are—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/a" id="article-4-3-a" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to establish and maintain a register of pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and premises at which a retail pharmacy business is, or is to be, carried on;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/b" id="article-4-3-b" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to set and promote standards for the safe and effective practice of pharmacy at registered pharmacies;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/c" id="article-4-3-c" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to set requirements by reference to which registrants must demonstrate that their fitness to practise is not impaired;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/d" id="article-4-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to promote the safe and effective practice of pharmacy by registrants (including, for example, by reference to any code of conduct for, and ethics relating to, pharmacy);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/e" id="article-4-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to set standards and requirements in respect of the education, training, acquisition of experience and continuing professional development that it is necessary for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians to achieve in order to be entered in the Register or to receive an annotation in the Register and to maintain competence; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/3/f" id="article-4-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to ensure the continued fitness to practise of registrants.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/4" id="article-4-4" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Council has the functions conferred on it by this Order and such other functions as may be conferred on it by the Privy Council by order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/5" id="article-4-5" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Before making an order under paragraph (4), the Privy Council must consult the Council.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6" id="article-4-6" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Council must have the following committees—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/a" id="article-4-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Investigating Committee;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/b" id="article-4-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Fitness to Practise Committee; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/6/c" id="article-4-6-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Appeals Committee,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>and each of those committees has the functions assigned to it by or under this Order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/7" id="article-4-7" RestrictStartDate="2010-09-27">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Council may establish such other committees as it considers appropriate in connection with the discharge of its functions and may delegate any of its functions to them, except any power to make rules.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/231/article/4/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/231/article/4/8" id="article-4-8" RestrictStartDate="2010-02-11">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Schedule 1 makes further provision about the Council, its committees, its staff, its publications and its accounts.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2011_1881/d8aea2b60c.xml: <Legislation><P1group AltVersionRefs="v10010" Concurrent="true" RestrictExtent="E+W+S" RestrictStartDate="2020-12-31"><Title>Protection of  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1659201037688" CommentaryRef="key-E">UK</Substitution>  marking</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39" id="regulation-39"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="M_E_2b88617a-5da6-48b2-a8ab-a7a647dfbf1b"/>39</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/1/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/1" id="regulation-39-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A person must not affix a  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1659201111285" CommentaryRef="key-E">UK</Substitution>  marking in relation to a toy unless—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/1/a/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/1/a" id="regulation-39-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the person is—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/1/a/i/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/1/a/i" id="regulation-39-1-a-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the manufacturer; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/1/a/ii/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1881/regulation/39/1/a/ii" id="regulation-39-1-a-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>an authorised representative of the manufacturer who has been appointed by the manufacturer <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>... to affix the  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1659201152355" CommentaryRef="key-E">UK</Substitution>  marking on the manufacturer's behalf; UK_uksi_2012_1916/0b0fa2c9b0.xml: <Legislation><P1group RestrictStartDate="2025-01-01"><Title>Conditions of UK marketing authorisation <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1653916306567" CommentaryRef="key-E">or parallel import licence</Addition>: exceptional circumstances</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60" id="regulation-60"><Pnumber>60</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/1" id="regulation-60-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The licensing authority may—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/1/a" id="regulation-60-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>grant a UK marketing authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1653916640609" CommentaryRef="key-E">or parallel import licence</Addition> subject to conditions in accordance with the following paragraphs of this regulation; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/1/b" id="regulation-60-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>vary or remove such a condition to which the UK marketing authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1653916662496" CommentaryRef="key-E">or parallel import licence</Addition> is subject.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/2" id="regulation-60-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The powers in paragraph (1) may be exercised only after consultation with the applicant for the authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1653916849739" CommentaryRef="key-E2">or licence</Addition> or (as the case may be) its holder.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/3" id="regulation-60-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The power in paragraph (1)(a) to grant an authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E3-1653916974281" CommentaryRef="key-E3">or licence</Addition> subject to conditions may be exercised only—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/3/a" id="regulation-60-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in exceptional circumstances; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/3/b" id="regulation-60-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>when the applicant can show that the applicant is unable to provide comprehensive data on the efficacy and safety of the medicinal product under normal conditions of use.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/4" id="regulation-60-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The conditions must relate to a matter addressed by Annex I to the 2001 Directive.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/5" id="regulation-60-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The conditions may, in particular, relate to the safety of the product to which the authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1653916883278" CommentaryRef="key-E2">or licence</Addition> relates.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/6" id="regulation-60-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The conditions may, in particular, require that, where there is a serious adverse reaction relating to the use of the product—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/6/a" id="regulation-60-6-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the reaction must be reported to the licensing authority; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/6/b" id="regulation-60-6-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>such other action as may be specified in the conditions must be taken.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/7" id="regulation-60-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The licensing authority must keep under review—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/7/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/7/a" id="regulation-60-7-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the conditions under this regulation to which a UK marketing authorisation <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1653916708706" CommentaryRef="key-E">or parallel import licence</Addition>  is subject; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/7/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/7/b" id="regulation-60-7-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the holder's compliance with those conditions.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/8" id="regulation-60-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The licensing authority must consider those matters no less frequently than—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/8/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/8/a" id="regulation-60-8-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>at the end of the period of one year beginning with the date on which the authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1653916906390" CommentaryRef="key-E2">or licence</Addition> was granted; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/8/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/8/b" id="regulation-60-8-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>at the end of each subsequent period of one year.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/9" id="regulation-60-9"><Pnumber><Substitution ChangeId="key-E4-1653917000377" CommentaryRef="key-E4">9</Substitution></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Substitution ChangeId="key-E4-1653917000377" CommentaryRef="key-E4">The licensing authority must notify the EMA of any UKMA(NI) or  </Substitution><Substitution ChangeId="key-E4-1653917000377" CommentaryRef="key-E4"><Substitution ChangeId="key-E5-1736412331718" CommentaryRef="key-E5">UKMA(UK)(Category 2)</Substitution></Substitution><Substitution ChangeId="key-E4-1653917000377" CommentaryRef="key-E4">  that it has granted subject to a condition included in accordance with this regulation.</Substitution></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/10" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/10" id="regulation-60-10"><Pnumber>10</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The holder of the authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E2-1653916933818" CommentaryRef="key-E2">or licence</Addition> must incorporate any condition included in a marketing authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E6-1653917021487" CommentaryRef="key-E6">or licence</Addition> in accordance with this regulation into the risk management system for the product.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/11" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1916/regulation/60/11" id="regulation-60-11"><Pnumber>11</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Schedule 11 makes provision about advice and representations in relation to proposals to vary or remove a condition to which a UK marketing authorisation  <Addition ChangeId="key-E-1653916779485" CommentaryRef="key-E">or parallel import licence</Addition> is subject.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in reg. 60 inserted (31.12.2020) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2019/775" id="d33e5" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument" Year="2019" Number="775">S.I. 2019/775</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="d33e5" id="cc109504152220" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2019/775/regulation/66/a" Operative="true" Cosmetics Regulation, or RAMS, the authority shall be liable to pay compensation to any person having an interest in the goods in respect of any loss or damage caused by reason of the taking of those measures if—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/1/a/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/1/a" id="regulation-17-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>no contravention of the <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>... Cosmetics Regulation has occurred or is likely to occur; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/1/b/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/1/b" id="regulation-17-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the exercise of the power is not attributable to any neglect or default by that person.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/2/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/2" id="regulation-17-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where an officer of an enforcement authority exercises any power under paragraph 4 of Schedule 2 to seize and detain goods the enforcement authority shall be liable to pay compensation to any person having an interest in the goods in respect of any loss or damage caused by reason of the taking of those measures if—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/2/a/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/2/a" id="regulation-17-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>no contravention of the <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>... Cosmetics Regulation has occurred or is likely to occur; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/2/b/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/2/b" id="regulation-17-2-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the exercise of the power is not attributable to any neglect or default by that person.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/3/england+wales+scotland" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1478/regulation/17/3" id="regulation-17-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Any disputed question as to the right to or the amount of any compensation payable under this section shall be determined by arbitration or, in Scotland, by a single arbiter appointed, failing agreement between the parties, by the sheriff.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries/></Legislation>

NumberOfProvisions="8" id="part-8" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2020-12-31"><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2017-03-31"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26" id="regulation-26"><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/1" id="regulation-26-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Unless the conditions in paragraph (5) are satisfied, before supplying water for regulation 4(1) purposes, a water undertaker or  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134817530" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution> must—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/1/a" id="regulation-26-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>disinfect the water, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/1/b" id="regulation-26-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>where necessary, subject the water to sufficient preliminary treatment to prepare it for disinfection.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/4" id="regulation-26-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Unless the conditions in paragraph (5) are satisfied, before supplying water for regulation 4(1) purposes using water from any source, a water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134848105" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution> must design and continuously operate an adequate treatment process for water from the source.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/5" id="regulation-26-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The conditions are that the water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134865967" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution>—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/5/a" id="regulation-26-5-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>must supply water from the treatment works as a matter of urgency in order to prevent an unexpected interruption in piped supply to consumers, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/26/5/b" id="regulation-26-5-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>before the supply is made, has taken all necessary steps to inform consumers that the water is not disinfected or adequately treated.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2017-03-31"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27" id="regulation-27"><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27/2" id="regulation-27-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Every water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134876872" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution> must carry out a risk assessment of each of its treatment works and connected supply system in order to establish whether there is a significant risk of supplying water from those works or supply system that could constitute a potential danger to human health or is likely to be unwholesome.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27/3" id="regulation-27-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Every water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134885795" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution> must keep its risk assessments under continuous review.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27/4" id="regulation-27-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Secretary of State may by notice served on a water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134893143" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution> require a risk assessment or review to be carried out by a date specified in the notice.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/27/5" id="regulation-27-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where a water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134899180" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution> becomes aware of any factors which make it likely that a risk assessment under this regulation would establish that there is a significant risk of supplying water that would constitute a potential danger to human health or that is likely to be unwholesome, it must notify the Secretary of State specifying the relevant factors.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2017-03-31"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28" id="regulation-28"><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/1" id="regulation-28-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>As soon as reasonably practicable after a water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134905888" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution> has carried out a risk assessment or review of such assessment under regulation 27, it must submit to the Secretary of State a report of the assessment or review.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/3" id="regulation-28-3"><P2para><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/3/b" id="regulation-28-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>specify the measures to mitigate the risk that the water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134912658" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution>—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/3/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/3/b/i" id="regulation-28-3-b-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>has made operational as at the date of the report, and</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/3/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/3/b/ii" id="regulation-28-3-b-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>intends to make operational.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4" id="regulation-28-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where the Secretary of State has received a report which states that there is or has been a significant risk of supplying water that could constitute a potential danger to human health or could be unwholesome, the Secretary of State may, by notice served on the water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134921597" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution>, require the water undertaker or <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1536134932642" CommentaryRef="key-E">wholesale licensee</Substitution>—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/a" id="regulation-28-4-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to maintain such specified measures for such period of time as the Secretary of State considers appropriate to mitigate the risk;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/b" id="regulation-28-4-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to review, revise or make operational such specified measures by such date as the Secretary of State considers appropriate to mitigate the risk;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/c" id="regulation-28-4-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to audit whether the measures have been effective by such means as may be specified;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/d" id="regulation-28-4-d"><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>not to supply water for regulation 4(1) purposes from specified treatment works or supply systems, or not to so supply unless specified conditions are satisfied;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/614/regulation/28/4/e" id="regulation-28-4-e"><Pnumber>e</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to give the Secretary of State such information as the Secretary of State may require to monitor progress towards mitigation of that risk.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Part><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in regs. 26-28 substituted (31.3.2017) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/506" id="c3b67edz3-00016" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument" Year="2017" Number="506" Title="The Water Act 2014 (Consequential Amendments etc.) Order 2017">The Water Act 2014 (Consequential Amendments etc.) Order 2017 (S.I. 2017/506)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef id="c3b67edz3-00017" CitationRef="c3b67edz3-00016" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/506/article/1/1" SectionRef="article-1-1">arts. 1(1)</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef id="c3b67edz3-00018" CitationRef="c3b67edz3-00016" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/506/article/32/4" SectionRef="article-32-4" Operative="true">32(4)</CitationSubRef></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2016_765/1e6329f5f0.xml: <Legislation><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/43/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/43/3/a" id="article-43-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>when the aircraft is weighed, prepare a weight schedule showing—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/43/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/43/3/a/i" id="article-43-3-a-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the mass, or such other weight as may be approved by the CAA <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>... for that aircraft; and</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/43/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/43/3/a/ii" id="article-43-3-a-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the position of the centre of gravity at its mass or such other position of the centre of gravity as may be approved by the CAA <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>... for that aircraft.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2016_765/3d7972edcd.xml: <Legislation><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92" id="article-92"><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2" id="article-92-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A relevant aircraft which is launched, moored, tethered or  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1579696293332" CommentaryRef="key-E">ground towed</Substitution>  must not be operated—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/a" id="article-92-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in such a manner as to—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/a/i" id="article-92-2-a-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>represent a hazard to other airspace users; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/a/ii" id="article-92-2-a-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>without the permission of the CAA, result in any part of the relevant aircraft whilst it is being launched or  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1579696345465" CommentaryRef="key-E">ground towed</Substitution>, or its tether, mooring or towing equipment, extending more than 60 metres above ground level;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/b" id="article-92-2-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>within <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/>... airspace notified for the purpose of this article;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/c" id="article-92-2-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>within the aerodrome traffic zone of a notified aerodrome during the notified operating hours of that aerodrome except—</Text><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/c/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/c/i" id="article-92-2-c-i"><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>during the day and in Visual Meteorological Conditions; and</Text></P4para></P4><P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/c/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/2/c/ii" id="article-92-2-c-ii"><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>with the permission of the person in charge of the aerodrome, the appropriate air traffic control unit or the CAA.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/765/article/92/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/765/article/92/3" id="article-92-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A relevant aircraft which is flown, launched, moored, tethered or  <Substitution ChangeId="key-E-1579696378647" CommentaryRef="key-E">ground towed</Substitution>  must be operated in accordance with any guidance issued from time to time by the CAA relating to such operation.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1><Commentaries><Commentary id="key-E" Type="F"><Para><Text>Words in art. 92(2)(3) substituted (14.12.2017) by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1112" id="cnbjf66v3-00011" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument" Year="2017" Number="1112" Title="The Air Navigation (Amendment) Order 2017">The Air Navigation (Amendment) Order 2017 (S.I. 2017/1112)</Citation>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cnbjf66v3-00011" id="cnbjf66v3-00012" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1112/article/1" SectionRef="article-1">arts. 1</CitationSubRef>, <CitationSubRef CitationRef="cnbjf66v3-00011" id="cnbjf66v3-00013" URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1112/article/22/a" SectionRef="article-22-a" Operative="true">22(a)</CitationSubRef></Text></Para></Commentary></Commentaries></Legislation>

<Legislation><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2018-04-11">
<Title>Transfer of functions etc to the Secretary of State for Housing, Communities and Local Government</Title>
<P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/378/article/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/378/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The functions of the Secretary of State for Communities and Local Government are transferred to the Secretary of State for Housing, Communities and Local Government.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/378/article/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/378/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E2"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>There are transferred to the Secretary of State for Housing, Communities and Local Government all property, rights and liabilities to which the Secretary of State for Communities and Local Government is entitled or subject at the coming into force of this Order.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group><Commentaries/></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2019_1115/57b5f340fa.xml: <Legislation><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2019/1115/article/6/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2019/1115/article/6/2" id="article-6-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where an operator has completed a risk assessment (the  “previous risk assessment”) in relation to an operation of aircraft <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>..., no further risk assessment needs to be conducted in relation to that operation, but a further risk assessment must be conducted if—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2019/1115/article/6/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2019/1115/article/6/2/a" id="article-6-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the operator has reason to suspect that the previous risk assessment is no longer valid;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2019/1115/article/6/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2019/1115/article/6/2/b" id="article-6-2-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>there has been a significant change to the matters to which the previous risk assessment relates; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2019/1115/article/6/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2019/1115/article/6/2/c" id="article-6-2-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the operator has reasonable cause to believe that a crew member has received an overexposure while performing duties for the operator on board that aircraft <CommentaryRef Ref="key-E"/>....</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><Commentaries/></Legislation>
